fine employer not giving written terms

dismissal_late_suit_two_weeks.title: Missed the three weeks through no fault of your own: apply within two weeks, at most six months late
dismissal_late_suit_two_weeks.summary: A late dismissal suit may be admitted if, despite all reasonable care, you could not file within three weeks. The application has to be made within two weeks after the obstacle ends and no later than six months after the missed deadline. Pregnant women who learn of the pregnancy only after the deadline for reasons they are not responsible for are also covered.

dismissal_add_reasons_until_hearing.title: Once you sued in time, you can add other reasons why the dismissal is invalid until the hearing
dismissal_add_reasons_until_hearing.summary: If you filed in time claiming that the dismissal was not valid, you can rely on further reasons of invalidity until the end of the oral hearing at the first-instance court, even if you did not name them within the three weeks.

dismissal_court_severance_cap.title: If the court ends the job against severance: up to 12 monthly salaries, more for long service
dismissal_court_severance_cap.summary: If continued employment is unreasonable, the court can dissolve the employment against severance of up to twelve monthly earnings. The cap is fifteen monthly earnings for employees aged 50 or over with at least 15 years of service, and eighteen for those aged 55 or over with at least 20 years.

statutory_severance_half_month_per_year.title: Operational dismissal with severance offer: half a monthly pay per year of service
statutory_severance_half_month_per_year.summary: For a dismissal for operational reasons, if the notice states that you can claim severance if you do not sue within three weeks, and you do not sue, you are entitled to 0.5 monthly earnings for every year of service. A period of more than six months in the last year is rounded up to a full year.

social_selection_criteria.title: Operational dismissals: the employer must weigh service, age, dependants and disability
social_selection_criteria.summary: When dismissing for operational reasons the employer has to take into account length of service, age, maintenance duties and severe disability when choosing whom to let go. Employees with special skills or needed for a balanced workforce structure may be left out of the selection. The employee has to prove that the selection was unfair.

small_firm_threshold_and_part_timers.title: Dismissal protection threshold: five or fewer, or ten for newer hires; part-timers count less
small_firm_threshold_and_part_timers.summary: The general dismissal protection does not apply where five or fewer employees are regularly employed, excluding trainees. For employees hired after 31 December 2003 it applies only once the establishment regularly employs more than ten. Part-time employees count as 0.5 up to 20 hours a week and 0.75 up to 30 hours.

parttime_reduction_request.title: Asking to cut your hours: six months on the job and three months notice
parttime_reduction_request.summary: You can ask to reduce your contractual working hours if the employment has lasted more than six months and the employer has more than 15 employees. Ask in writing at least three months before the change starts. If the employer does not refuse in writing one month before the start date, the reduction takes effect as you requested.

parttime_preference_longer_hours.title: Part-time and want more hours: you get preference for open jobs
parttime_preference_longer_hours.summary: If you work part-time and tell your employer you want longer hours, the employer must give you preference for a suitable open position, unless there are urgent operational reasons or another employee has a stronger wish for the same job.

fixed_term_no_reason_limit.title: Fixed term without a reason: up to two years and three renewals
fixed_term_no_reason_limit.summary: A fixed-term contract without an objective reason is allowed for at most two years, and within those two years it can be renewed up to three times. It is not allowed if you already worked for the same employer before.

fixed_term_continued_work.title: Fixed term ended but you keep working: the job becomes permanent
fixed_term_continued_work.summary: If you keep working after a fixed-term contract expires and the employer knows it and does not object right away, the contract is treated as open-ended.

fixed_term_challenge_deadline.title: Challenging a fixed term: you have three weeks
fixed_term_challenge_deadline.summary: If you think the fixed term in your contract is not valid, you must go to the labour court within three weeks after the agreed end date. After that the term counts as valid.

fixed_term_permanent_info.title: Fixed-term staff must be told about permanent jobs
fixed_term_permanent_info.summary: The employer must tell fixed-term employees about suitable open-ended positions in the company that become free.

fixed_term_equal_treatment.title: Fixed-term staff may not be treated worse than permanent staff
fixed_term_equal_treatment.summary: A fixed-term employee may not be treated worse than a comparable permanent employee just because the contract is limited, unless there is an objective reason.

milog_intern_under18.title: Minimum wage does not apply to under-18s without vocational training
milog_intern_under18.summary: Minors without completed vocational training are not covered by the statutory minimum wage under the MiLoG.

milog_long_term_unemployed.title: Long-term unemployed: no minimum wage for the first six months
milog_long_term_unemployed.summary: People who were unemployed for a year or longer can be employed for the first six months without the statutory minimum wage.

parental_leave_part_time_32h.title: Working during parental leave: up to 32 hours a week
parental_leave_part_time_32h.summary: During parental leave you may work part-time up to 32 hours per week on average per month.

parental_leave_part_time_request.title: Part-time during parental leave: ask seven or thirteen weeks ahead
parental_leave_part_time_request.summary: To work part-time during parental leave, ask in writing seven weeks ahead for a child up to three years, or thirteen weeks ahead for the period between the third and eighth birthday. If the employer does not refuse in writing within four weeks (eight weeks for the older period) the request is deemed approved. You can request a reduction twice during the leave.

parental_leave_dismissal_window.title: Parental leave dismissal protection starts eight or fourteen weeks before
parental_leave_dismissal_window.summary: Dismissal protection starts at the earliest eight weeks before the leave begins (fourteen weeks if the leave is between the third and eighth birthday). A dismissal needs prior approval of the competent authority.

minors_working_hours_8_40.title: Under 18: at most 8 hours a day and 40 hours a week
minors_working_hours_8_40.summary: Young people under 18 may not work more than eight hours a day or 40 hours a week. Around public holidays hours can be shifted so the five-week average stays at 40, but a day may not exceed 8.5 hours.

minors_breaks.title: Under 18: 30 minutes break after 4.5 hours, 60 after 6
minors_breaks.summary: Young workers get a 30-minute break when work lasts more than 4.5 hours and 60 minutes when it lasts more than six. Only blocks of at least 15 minutes count, and they may not work more than 4.5 hours without a break.

minors_daily_rest_12h.title: Under 18: at least 12 hours of rest between shifts
minors_daily_rest_12h.summary: After finishing work, a person under 18 needs at least twelve consecutive hours free before the next shift.

minors_night_work.title: Under 18: work only between 6:00 and 20:00, with sector exceptions
minors_night_work.summary: In general young people may only work between 6:00 and 20:00. Over-16s may work until 22:00 in hospitality and fairground work, and until 23:00 in multi-shift operations. In bakeries over-16s may start from 5:00.

minors_five_day_week_weekends.title: Under 18: five-day week, and weekends mostly off
minors_five_day_week_weekends.summary: Young workers may work only five days a week. Saturdays and Sundays are off except in listed sectors such as hospitality, healthcare, retail and bakeries, and at least two Saturdays and two Sundays a month must stay free. If they work a Saturday or Sunday they get a free workday in the same week.

minors_holidays_24_31_dec.title: Under 18: no work on public holidays, and not after 14:00 on 24 and 31 December
minors_holidays_24_31_dec.summary: Young people may not work on public holidays or after 14:00 on 24 and 31 December. Exceptions follow the Sunday sectors, but never on 25 December, 1 January, Easter Sunday or 1 May.

minors_paid_leave_days.title: Under 18: at least 25 to 30 working days of paid leave
minors_paid_leave_days.summary: Minimum paid leave depends on age on 1 January: under 16 at least 30 working days, under 17 at least 27, under 18 at least 25. Leave should fall in school holidays; otherwise one extra day for each school day attended.

minors_vocational_school.title: Under 18: employer must release you for school, and school time counts as work time
minors_vocational_school.summary: Employers must release young people for vocational school. No work before classes that start before 9:00, and on a school day with more than five lessons only once a week. School time counts toward working hours and pay may not be cut for it.
keywords: teen school counts as work time

minors_holiday_job_15.title: Holiday job at 15: allowed for at most four weeks a year
minors_holiday_job_15.summary: Children under 15 may not be employed. Young people of 15 who are still in full-time schooling may work during school holidays for at most four weeks per calendar year.

modernisation_rent_eight_percent.title: After modernisation the landlord can add 8% of the costs per year
modernisation_rent_eight_percent.summary: A landlord who has carried out qualifying modernisation may raise the annual rent by 8% of the costs spent on the flat. Costs that would only have been ordinary repairs do not count, and costs of work covering several flats must be split fairly.

modernisation_rent_cap_per_sqm.title: Modernisation rent rise is capped at 3 euro per square metre in six years
modernisation_rent_cap_per_sqm.summary: Within six years the monthly rent may rise by no more than 3 euro per square metre of living space through modernisation, or 2 euro if the rent before was below 7 euro per square metre.
keywords: rent increase cap six years modernisation

modernisation_hardship_deadline.title: Modernisation hardship: it only counts if you raised it in time
modernisation_hardship_deadline.summary: A modernisation rent increase is barred to the extent it would be a hardship for the tenant that is not justified even after weighing the landlord's interests. Hardship counts only if raised in time, and any agreement that makes this worse for the tenant is void.

rent_brake_thirty_months.title: Rent brake: complain within 30 months or only rent after the complaint comes back
rent_brake_thirty_months.summary: You can reclaim rent that exceeded the rent brake only after you have objected to the violation. If you object more than 30 months after the tenancy began, or after it ended, you only get back rent that fell due after the objection arrived.

rent_brake_landlord_information_duty.title: Rent brake: the landlord must tell you before signing why the rent is higher
rent_brake_landlord_information_duty.summary: Before the contract is signed the landlord must volunteer information if he relies on an exception: the previous rent, recent modernisation, first letting after 1 October 2014, or first letting after comprehensive modernisation. Without it he cannot rely on that exception until he provides it properly, in text form.

sperrzeit_job_refusal_tiers.title: Refusing a job the agency offers: block of 3, then 6, then 12 weeks
sperrzeit_job_refusal_tiers.summary: If you refuse or obstruct a job the employment agency offers without a good reason, unemployment benefit is blocked for three weeks the first time, six weeks the second time and twelve weeks after that.

sperrzeit_late_registration.title: Missing an appointment or registering late: one week of blocked benefit
sperrzeit_late_registration.summary: Missing an agency appointment after a warning, or registering late as job-seeking, leads to a block of one week.

alg_short_qualifying_period.title: Short fixed-term jobs: six months of insured work can be enough for Arbeitslosengeld
alg_short_qualifying_period.summary: Normally you need twelve months of insured employment in the reference period. If you do not reach that, six months is enough when most of your employment days came from jobs fixed for at most 14 weeks in advance, and your pay in the last twelve months did not exceed 1.5 times the Bezugsgröße.

apprentice_probation_termination.title: Apprenticeship probation: either side can quit any time without notice
apprentice_probation_termination.summary: During the probation period a training contract can be ended at any time without a notice period, by the trainee or the training company.

apprentice_quit_after_probation.title: Apprenticeship after probation: quit with four weeks notice only to give up or change career
apprentice_quit_after_probation.summary: After probation the contract ends only for a serious reason without notice, or by the trainee with four weeks notice if they give up training or want to train for another occupation. The notice must be in writing, and the trainee must state the reasons.

apprentice_termination_two_weeks.title: Apprenticeship: a termination for serious reason is void after two weeks
apprentice_termination_two_weeks.summary: A termination for a serious reason is invalid if the person terminating has known the facts for more than two weeks. Termination must be on paper, not by email.
keywords: serious reason two week deadline trainee

apprentice_pay_rises_yearly.title: Apprentices: pay must be appropriate and rise at least every year
apprentice_pay_rises_yearly.summary: The training company must pay an appropriate wage, and it must rise as training advances, at least once a year.

apprentice_minimum_pay_later_years.title: Apprentice minimum pay: +18% in year two, +35% in year three, +40% in year four
apprentice_minimum_pay_later_years.summary: There is a statutory minimum monthly pay for the first training year, set by the year training began. The minimum rises by 18% in the second year, 35% in the third and 40% in the fourth, calculated from the first-year amount.

apprentice_pay_below_collective.title: Apprentice pay more than 20% under the collective rate is not appropriate
apprentice_pay_below_collective.summary: If the employer is not bound by a collective agreement, pay that is more than 20% below the relevant collective rate is generally not appropriate, even if it meets the statutory minimum.

apprentice_overtime_pay.title: Apprentices: extra hours must be paid or taken as time off
apprentice_overtime_pay.summary: Work beyond the agreed regular daily training time must be paid extra or compensated with equivalent time off.

apprentice_in_kind_75_percent.title: Apprentices: meals or housing can count toward pay, but at most 75%
apprentice_in_kind_75_percent.summary: Non-cash benefits such as meals or accommodation can count toward the training pay at official values, but not for more than 75% of the gross pay.

bafoeg_extension_reasons.title: BAföG beyond the standard period: serious reasons, caring for a relative, committee work, failed final exam
bafoeg_extension_reasons.summary: BAföG can be extended by an appropriate time beyond the maximum funding period for serious reasons, home care of a close relative at care level 3 or higher, work in university or student bodies, failing the final exam for the first time, or disability, pregnancy or raising a child under 14.

bafoeg_degree_completion_help.title: Hilfe zum Studienabschluss: up to 12 more months of BAföG for the final stretch
bafoeg_degree_completion_help.summary: For self-contained degree programmes BAföG can continue for up to 12 months after the maximum period if you were admitted to the final exam within four semesters of that point, and the examination office confirms you can finish within those 12 months. It is paid as a loan.

bafoeg_other_training_full_loan.title: BAföG for another degree after switching: paid as a full loan beyond the funding period
bafoeg_other_training_full_loan.summary: At universities, support is a full loan (no grant) for another training course whose semesters exceed the maximum funding period, which is shortened by semesters already completed in the earlier course. This does not apply if you stopped or changed field for a good or unavoidable reason.

family_insurance_child_age_limits.title: Family insurance for children: to 18, to 23 if not working, to 25 in training or studies
family_insurance_child_age_limits.summary: Children are covered through a parent free of charge up to 18 without further conditions, up to 23 if not employed, and up to 25 if in school, vocational training or a voluntary social or ecological year.
keywords: child covered parents insurance age limit

family_insurance_service_extension.title: Family insurance runs past 25 by the length of statutory or voluntary service
family_insurance_service_extension.summary: Interruptions of training for statutory service, certain voluntary services or work as a development worker extend family insurance beyond 25 by the length of that service, up to 12 months for development work.

family_insurance_disability_no_limit.title: Family insurance without age limit for children with a disability who cannot support themselves
family_insurance_disability_no_limit.summary: There is no age limit for children with a disability who cannot support themselves, if the disability existed while they were covered within the age limits.
keywords: no age limit insured via parents

kindergeld_unemployed_under_21.title: Kindergeld for 18 to 20 year olds without a job: they must register as job-seeking
kindergeld_unemployed_under_21.summary: A child who is 18 but not yet 21 still counts if they are not employed and registered as a job seeker with a German employment agency.

kindergeld_voluntary_service.title: Kindergeld during a voluntary service until 25
kindergeld_voluntary_service.summary: A child under 25 still counts while doing a recognised voluntary service such as a voluntary social or ecological year, federal voluntary service or an international volunteer programme.

neighbour_disturbance_termination.title: Serious repeated noise or disturbance of the peace: either side can end the lease
neighbour_disturbance_termination.summary: Either landlord or tenant may terminate if the other seriously and repeatedly disturbs the peace of the building. It is justified only if continuing until the normal notice period ends would be unreasonable, weighing all circumstances, fault and both sides' interests.

rent_arrears_after_rent_increase_judgmen.title: After a court orders a higher rent, the landlord must wait two months before ending the lease for arrears
rent_arrears_after_rent_increase_judgmen.summary: If the tenant has been legally ordered to pay an increased rent under §§ 558–560, the landlord cannot terminate for late payment before two months after the judgment becomes final.
keywords: court ordered higher rent two months

void_extra_termination_clauses.title: Lease clauses giving the landlord extra termination rights are void
void_extra_termination_clauses.summary: Clauses that disadvantage the tenant by deviating from the immediate-termination rules are void, and so are clauses giving the landlord extraordinary termination rights beyond those set by law.

warranty_presumption_animals_six_months.title: Buying a live animal from a trader: the defect presumption lasts six months, not one year
warranty_presumption_animals_six_months.summary: For goods in general, a defect that shows up within one year after delivery is presumed to have existed at the start. When a living animal is bought the presumption period is six months. It does not apply if it is incompatible with the nature of the goods or the type of defect.

warranty_digital_elements_two_years.title: Smart devices with digital features: the defect presumption can run two years
warranty_digital_elements_two_years.summary: For goods with digital elements where permanent provision of those elements was agreed, a deviation that appears during the provision period, or within two years of delivery, is presumed to have existed during the provision period up to that point.
keywords: smart device software defect two years

withdrawal_start_split_deliveries.title: Withdrawal period for split orders: it starts when the last item arrives
withdrawal_start_split_deliveries.summary: For several goods ordered together but delivered separately, the 14 days start when the last item arrives. For goods delivered in partial shipments, it is the last shipment, and for recurring deliveries over a set period it is the first delivery.

withdrawal_services_early_start.title: Services: you lose your withdrawal right once the service is fully delivered, if you agreed to an early start
withdrawal_services_early_start.summary: For a paid service, the right to withdraw ends on full performance if, before it began, you expressly agreed that it would start within the withdrawal period, gave that consent on a durable medium and confirmed that you know the right is lost. Free services end it on full performance, and a repair visit you asked for works the same way.

withdrawal_digital_content_start.title: Digital content: the withdrawal right ends when the download or streaming starts, if you agreed
withdrawal_digital_content_start.summary: For digital content not on a physical medium, the withdrawal right expires when the trader begins performance, if you expressly agreed to the early start, confirmed that you know the right will be lost and the trader gave the confirmation under § 312f. Free digital content: the right ends once the trader begins.

phone_contract_twelve_month_offer.title: Phone and internet provider must also offer you a contract of 12 months or less
phone_contract_twelve_month_offer.summary: The initial term of a consumer contract with a telecom provider may not exceed 24 months, and before signing the provider must also offer you a contract with an initial term of no more than 12 months.

phone_renewal_notice_duty.title: Before an automatic renewal the provider must tell you in good time
phone_renewal_notice_duty.summary: If a telecom contract renews automatically, the provider must inform you in good time on a durable medium about the renewal, how to prevent it by cancelling on time, and your right to cancel the renewed contract with one month notice.

phone_early_exit_devices.title: Ending a phone contract early: the provider may only claim the value of devices you keep
phone_early_exit_devices.summary: When early termination is allowed, the provider may not demand compensation beyond the value of retained devices, which cannot exceed the pro-rata value agreed at signing or the remaining fees. After you pay it the provider must free the devices, at no cost, from restrictions on use in other networks.

phone_email_access_after_end.title: After your internet contract ends you keep access to your provider email for a reasonable time
phone_email_access_after_end.summary: Internet access providers must make sure, free of charge, that you keep access for a reasonable period after the contract ends to emails under the provider's mail domain, and can forward them to another address.

terms_change_notice_three_months.title: Provider changes your telecom contract: you get 1 to 2 months notice and three months to cancel
terms_change_notice_three_months.summary: If standard terms let the provider change the contract unilaterally and it does so, you can terminate without notice period and at no cost. The provider must notify you one to two months before the change takes effect, in a clear way on a durable medium, naming the change, the date and your termination right. You can terminate within three months after receiving a proper notice, but not before the change takes effect.
keywords: three months to terminate after notice
notice one to two months before change

order_for_payment_not_checked.title: A Mahnbescheid does not mean the claim is justified: the court did not check it
order_for_payment_not_checked.summary: The payment order must state that the court has not checked whether the applicant is entitled to the claim, ask you to pay within two weeks of service or tell the court whether and how far you dispute the claim, and warn that an enforcement order can follow.

enforcement_order_equals_default_judgmen.title: A Vollstreckungsbescheid has the force of a default judgment
enforcement_order_equals_default_judgmen.summary: An enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid) has the same effect as a default judgment that has been declared provisionally enforceable. If an objection (Einspruch) is filed, the court transfers the case to the court named in the payment order.

tenant_right_accessibility_ev_burglar_so.title: You can ask the landlord to allow barrier-free changes, EV charging, burglar protection or plug-in solar
tenant_right_accessibility_ev_burglar_so.summary: A tenant can demand that the landlord allows structural changes that serve use by people with disabilities, charging electric vehicles, burglar protection or electricity from plug-in solar devices. There is no claim if the change is unreasonable for the landlord even after weighing the tenant's interests. The tenant can agree to provide special security, and clauses that disadvantage the tenant are void.

landlord_lien_scope.title: Landlord lien: only on your things that can be seized, and not for future claims
landlord_lien_scope.summary: The landlord has a lien on the tenant's belongings brought into the flat for claims from the tenancy, but not on things that cannot be seized. It cannot be asserted for future compensation claims or for rent later than the current and following rental year.
keywords: landlord keep my things unpaid rent

landlord_lien_removal.title: Landlord lien ends when your belongings leave the property, unless removed behind his back
landlord_lien_removal.summary: The landlord's lien ends when the things are removed from the property, unless this happens without his knowledge or against his objection. He cannot object if the removal fits ordinary living circumstances.
keywords: moving out belongings landlord lien ends

landlord_lien_other_creditors.title: When another creditor seizes your things, the landlord lien covers only the last year of rent
landlord_lien_other_creditors.summary: If a thing subject to the landlord's lien is seized for another creditor, the lien cannot be asserted against that creditor for rent for a period earlier than the last year before the seizure.
keywords: creditor seizes my things landlord lien

tenant_preemption_condominium.title: Your flat is sold after conversion into a condominium: you have a right of first refusal
tenant_preemption_condominium.summary: If rented flats are sold to a third party after condominium ownership was created, or is meant to be created, after you got the flat, the tenant has a right of first refusal. It does not apply if the landlord sells to a family member or a member of his household. The seller or the buyer must tell you the contract terms together with information about the right, and you exercise it by a written declaration to the seller. On the tenant's death it passes to those who enter the lease.

landlord_easier_termination_two_flat_hou.title: Landlord living in a house with up to two flats can end your lease without a reason, with 3 extra months
landlord_easier_termination_two_flat_hou.summary: A landlord who lives in the building (no more than two flats) can terminate a flat lease without a legitimate interest, but the notice period grows by three months. The same applies to rooms inside the landlord's own flat. The letter must state that the termination relies on this rule.
keywords: landlord lives in house no reason termination
two flat house termination without reason

landlord_no_termination_for_rent_increas.title: The landlord cannot end your lease just to raise the rent
landlord_no_termination_for_rent_increas.summary: A landlord can only terminate a residential lease if he has a legitimate interest in ending it, and termination for the purpose of a rent increase is excluded.
keywords: terminate lease to raise the rent
termination for the purpose of a rent increase

landlord_reasons_must_be_in_letter.title: Landlord notice: the reasons must be written in the letter, later reasons only count if new
landlord_reasons_must_be_in_letter.summary: The reasons for the landlord's legitimate interest must be stated in the termination letter. Other reasons are only considered if they arose afterwards.

tenant_return_subtenant.title: If you sublet, the landlord can reclaim the flat from your subtenant when the lease ends
tenant_return_subtenant.summary: If the tenant let a third person use the rented property, the landlord can also demand it back from that third person after the tenancy ended.
keywords: subtenant must leave when lease ends

rent_paid_in_advance_sale.title: Paid rent in advance to the old landlord and the flat was sold: only the current month is safe
rent_paid_in_advance_sale.summary: If the landlord disposed of the rent before ownership passed, that disposition is valid for the calendar month running at the time of transfer. A disposition for a later period must be accepted by the buyer only if he knew about it at the time ownership passed.
keywords: rent paid in advance flat sold

paid_short_personal_absence.title: Short absence for a personal reason: you keep your pay if it is not your fault and not long
paid_short_personal_absence.summary: An employee does not lose pay just because a personal reason, through no fault of his own, keeps him from work for a relatively short time. Amounts he receives from statutory health or accident insurance for that time are deducted. Contracts and collective agreements can limit or exclude this.

time_off_for_job_search_after_notice.title: After a notice of termination you can ask for reasonable time off to look for a new job
time_off_for_job_search_after_notice.summary: After notice of termination of a continuing employment, the employer must on request grant the employee reasonable time to look for another job.
keywords: time off job interviews after notice

noncompete_two_year_limit_and_minors.title: Non-compete limits: max two years, only for a real business interest, void for minors
noncompete_two_year_limit_and_minors.summary: A post-employment competition ban is not binding where it does not protect a legitimate business interest of the employer or where it unreasonably hinders the employee's career considering the compensation. It cannot run longer than two years after the job ends. It is void if the employee was a minor when it was signed, or if the employer made him promise on his word of honour.

pay_due_after_work_done.title: Pay is due after the work is done, and monthly pay at the end of each month
pay_due_after_work_done.summary: Remuneration is to be paid after the services have been performed. If it is measured by periods of time, it is due after each period has ended, so a monthly salary is due at the end of the month unless the contract says otherwise.

pay_when_employer_refuses_your_work.title: If the employer does not accept your work, you still get paid, minus what you saved or earned elsewhere
pay_when_employer_refuses_your_work.summary: If the employer is in default of acceptance, the employee can demand the agreed pay without working it later. He must accept a deduction for what he saves by not working or earns elsewhere or maliciously fails to earn. The same applies when the employer carries the risk of the work being cancelled.
keywords: employer sent me home no pay
shop closed no work still paid

employer_instructions_fair_discretion.title: The employer can set tasks, place and hours only within fair discretion and what the contract allows
employer_instructions_fair_discretion.summary: The employer may specify content, place and time of work at his fair discretion, as far as the contract, a works agreement, a collective agreement or a law has not fixed them. This covers order and conduct in the workplace. He must also take the employee's disabilities into account.

wages_in_euro_no_goods_on_credit.title: Wages must be paid in euros; goods instead of pay only by agreement and at cost price
wages_in_euro_no_goods_on_credit.summary: Pay must be calculated and paid in euros. Payment in kind can be agreed only if it suits the employee's interest or the nature of the job. The employer may not hand out goods on credit, and goods may be set off against pay only by agreement and at average cost. Their value may not exceed the garnishable part of the pay.
keywords: paid in goods instead of money

employer_sick_care_costs.title: If the employer houses you in a hospital while ill, he may only offset the costs against your pay
employer_sick_care_costs.summary: The employer can provide board and medical treatment by taking the sick employee into a hospital, and the costs may be set against the pay for the time of illness. A termination because of the illness under § 626 is disregarded.

tenant_damages_and_self_repair.title: Defect in your flat: damages, and you can fix it yourself if the landlord is late or it is urgent
tenant_damages_and_self_repair.summary: The tenant can claim damages if a defect existed at signing, arose later because of something the landlord is responsible for, or the landlord is late fixing it. The tenant may fix the defect himself and demand the necessary costs if the landlord is in default or if immediate repair is needed to preserve the property.

tenant_other_expenses_and_removal_right.title: Other money you spent on the flat, and fixtures you installed: what you can claim or take with you
tenant_other_expenses_and_removal_right.summary: Expenses on the rented property that the landlord does not owe under the defect rule can be reclaimed under the rules for management without authority. The tenant may also remove any installation he added to the property.
keywords: took my shelves kitchen when moving out

landlord_buyout_of_removal_right.title: The landlord can stop you removing fixtures by paying fair compensation, unless you have a good reason
landlord_buyout_of_removal_right.summary: The landlord can prevent the tenant from exercising his right to remove installations by paying reasonable compensation, unless the tenant has a legitimate interest in taking them away.
keywords: landlord pays compensation instead of removal
landlord wants to keep installed fixtures

landlord_injunction_after_warning.title: Using the flat against the lease: after a written warning the landlord can sue to make you stop
landlord_injunction_after_warning.summary: If the tenant keeps using the property in breach of the contract despite a warning from the landlord, the landlord can sue for an injunction to stop it.
keywords: landlord warning breach of lease use

utility_costs_default_by_living_area.title: Utility costs are split by living area unless the lease says otherwise, and metered use by consumption
utility_costs_default_by_living_area.summary: Unless the parties agreed otherwise, operating costs are divided by each flat's share of the living area. Costs that depend on measured consumption or measured causation by the tenants must be divided by a key that reflects the different use.
keywords: how are utility costs split between flats

agg_protected_grounds_scope.title: The AGG protects against discrimination on six listed grounds, from application to career progress
agg_protected_grounds_scope.summary: The equal treatment act aims to prevent or remove discrimination on grounds of race or ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity. It covers conditions for access to employed and self-employed work including selection criteria and hiring conditions, whatever the field or position, and career advancement. It also reaches areas such as social protection and health services.
keywords: which grounds does the agg protect
what counts as discrimination law germany

agg_lower_pay_protective_rules_no_excuse.title: Lower pay for the same work cannot be justified by saying a protective rule applies to you
agg_lower_pay_protective_rules_no_excuse.summary: Agreeing on lower pay for equal or equivalent work because of a protected ground is not justified by the fact that special protective rules exist for that ground.
keywords: lower pay same work protective rule

agg_age_differences_allowed_if_justified.title: Age-based differences are allowed only for a legitimate aim and with proportionate means
agg_age_differences_allowed_if_justified.summary: Different treatment because of age is permitted if it is objectively and reasonably justified by a legitimate aim and the means are appropriate and necessary. Examples listed include special conditions to help integrate young or older workers, and a maximum hiring age based on the training the job needs or a reasonable working time before retirement.
keywords: too old for the job discrimination

agg_employer_prevention_duty.title: The employer must actively prevent discrimination and act against employees who discriminate
agg_employer_prevention_duty.summary: The employer must take the measures needed to protect employees from discrimination, including preventive ones. Suitable training of staff counts as fulfilling the duty. If employees breach the ban on discrimination, the employer must take suitable, necessary and proportionate action such as a warning, transfer or dismissal. The law and the contact points for complaints must be made known in the workplace.
keywords: colleague discriminates what must employer do

agg_right_to_complain_at_work.title: You can complain to the right office at work if you feel discriminated against, and must get an answer
agg_right_to_complain_at_work.summary: Employees have the right to complain to the responsible bodies of the workplace, company or office if they feel disadvantaged for a protected reason by the employer, superiors, colleagues or third parties. The complaint must be examined and the result communicated to the employee.
keywords: where to complain discrimination at work

agg_no_retaliation_for_complaint.title: The employer may not punish you, or your supporters and witnesses, for using your discrimination rights
agg_no_retaliation_for_complaint.summary: The employer may not disadvantage employees because they assert their rights under the equal treatment act. The same protection applies to people who support the employee or testify as witnesses.

copyright_lasts_70_years.title: Copyright expires 70 years after the author dies, then the work is free to use
copyright_lasts_70_years.summary: The author's copyright ends seventy years after his death. After that the work is in the public domain, apart from separate rights such as those of later editors or photographers.

private_copy_limits.title: Private copies: single copies for yourself are allowed, but not from an obviously illegal source
private_copy_limits.summary: A natural person may make single copies of a work for private use on any medium as long as the copies serve no direct or indirect commercial purpose and the source is not obviously unlawfully produced or made available. The copies may not be distributed or used for public performance.
keywords: is it legal to copy a cd for myself
download from illegal source private copy

research_copies_15_75_percent.title: Research: up to 15 % shared with a research group, up to 75 % for your own, small works in full
research_copies_15_75_percent.summary: For non-commercial scientific research, up to 15 percent of a work may be reproduced and shared with a defined group of people for their own research, or with individual third parties checking the quality of the research. Up to 75 percent may be reproduced for one's own research. Illustrations, single articles from a journal, other short works and out-of-print works may be used in full.

copyright_of_work_created_in_a_job.title: What you create in your job: the copyright rules still apply, unless the job says otherwise
copyright_of_work_created_in_a_job.summary: The rules on authors' rights also apply when the author created the work to fulfil duties from an employment or service relationship, as far as the content or nature of the employment does not require something different.
keywords: who owns what i create at work

software_use_without_extra_licence.title: Authorised users of a program may do the copying needed for normal use, unless the contract says otherwise
software_use_without_extra_licence.summary: Unless special contract terms say otherwise, the acts of reproduction and alteration of a computer program do not need the rights holder's consent when they are necessary for the intended use of the program, including error correction, by anyone entitled to use a copy.
keywords: may i install software on two devices
fix bug in licensed program allowed

prescription_copayment_5_to_10_euro.title: Prescription drugs for adults: 10 % copayment, at least 5 and at most 10 euro, never more than the price
prescription_copayment_5_to_10_euro.summary: Insured people aged 18 or over pay a copayment for each prescribed drug or dressing covered by statutory insurance. It is 10 percent of the retail price, at least 5 euro and at most 10 euro, but never more than the cost of the product.
keywords: how much do i pay for prescription

consumable_aids_copayment_15_monthly.title: Consumable medical aids: 10 % copayment, capped at 15 euro for the whole month's supply
consumable_aids_copayment_15_monthly.summary: For aids that are used up, such as certain care and incontinence supplies, the copayment is 10 percent of the amount the health fund pays, with a maximum of 15 euro for the entire monthly need.

safety_costs_not_on_employees.title: The employer pays for workplace safety measures, he may not pass the cost on to you
safety_costs_not_on_employees.summary: Costs of occupational safety and health measures under the Occupational Safety Act may not be imposed on employees by the employer.

safety_complaint_to_authority.title: If your employer ignores a safety complaint, you can go to the authority
safety_complaint_to_authority.summary: If employees have concrete reasons to think that the employer's measures and equipment do not ensure safety and health at work, and the employer does not remedy their complaints, they can turn to the competent authority.

risk_assessment_duty.title: The employer must assess the risks of each job to decide which protective measures are needed
risk_assessment_duty.summary: The employer has to determine which occupational safety measures are necessary by assessing the risks that the work involves for employees. The assessment follows the type of activity, and for similar working conditions the assessment of one workplace or activity is enough.

sick_pay_starts_after_four_weeks.title: Sick pay from your employer only starts after four uninterrupted weeks in the job
sick_pay_starts_after_four_weeks.summary: The right to continued pay during illness arises only after the employment has lasted four weeks without interruption. Before that, the employer owes no sick pay and the health insurance fund may step in instead.
keywords: sick in first weeks of new job
ill during probation first month pay
erkrankt erste woche neuer job lohn

sick_pay_bonus_cut_quarter.title: Employers may cut a special bonus for sick days, but by no more than a quarter of a day's pay per day
sick_pay_bonus_cut_quarter.summary: An agreement may reduce extra payments on top of regular pay (special bonuses) for days of illness. The cut may not exceed one quarter of the average daily earnings per day of illness.

holiday_waiting_period_six_months.title: The full holiday entitlement is earned for the first time after six months in the job
holiday_waiting_period_six_months.summary: The full annual leave entitlement is acquired for the first time after the employment has existed for six months. Before that only a partial entitlement arises.

holiday_half_day_rounds_up.title: Partial holiday days of half a day or more are rounded up to a full day
holiday_half_day_rounds_up.summary: Fractions of holiday days that amount to at least half a day are rounded up to full days.
keywords: fractions of holiday days rounded up

holiday_rules_cannot_be_waived.title: You cannot be forced to give up statutory holiday: only collective agreements may deviate
holiday_rules_cannot_be_waived.summary: The holiday rules of the federal holiday act cannot be changed to the employee's disadvantage, except where the law allows deviation by collective agreement.

holiday_pay_before_departure.title: Holiday pay must be paid out before the holiday starts
holiday_pay_before_departure.summary: The pay for the holiday period has to be paid out before the employee starts the holiday.

working_hours_added_across_employers.title: Working for two employers: the hours are added up for the legal limits, breaks do not count
working_hours_added_across_employers.summary: Working time is the time from the start to the end of work without the rest breaks. Hours worked for several employers must be added together when applying the working time limits.

employer_notice_grows_with_service.title: If the employer ends the job, notice grows with service: one month after 2 years up to seven months after 20
employer_notice_grows_with_service.summary: When the employer gives notice, the period depends on how long the employment has lasted at the company: one month to the end of a calendar month after two years, two months after five, three after eight, four after ten, five after twelve, six after fifteen and seven months after twenty years.

how long notice after ten years
staffel kündigungsfrist zwei monate fünf jahre

extraordinary_dismissal_two_weeks_from_k.title: Dismissal without notice must come within two weeks of learning the facts, and you can ask for the reason in writing
extraordinary_dismissal_two_weeks_from_k.summary: A termination for good cause can only be declared within two weeks. The period starts when the person entitled to terminate learns of the facts that justify it. On request, the terminating party must give the reason in writing without delay.
keywords: employer waited month before firing for cause

no_punishment_for_asserting_rights.title: The employer may not disadvantage you for lawfully asserting your rights
no_punishment_for_asserting_rights.summary: An employer may not put an employee at a disadvantage in an agreement or measure because the employee lawfully exercises his rights.
keywords: retaliation employer after asking holiday pay

freelance_notice_by_pay_period.title: Freelance service contract without fixed notice: the period follows how the fee is calculated
freelance_notice_by_pay_period.summary: For service relationships that are not employment and have no agreed notice period, the notice depends on the pay period. If the remuneration is measured by months, notice must be given at the latest on the 15th of a month to end at the close of that month.

default_interest_five_points.title: If you pay late, default interest is five percentage points above the base rate
default_interest_five_points.summary: A money debt bears interest during default. The default rate is five percentage points above the base interest rate per year. Nine points apply only between transactions in which no consumer is involved.

no_40_euro_flat_against_consumers.title: The 40 euro late-payment flat fee does not apply to consumers
no_40_euro_flat_against_consumers.summary: A creditor can claim a flat 40 euro in addition to default interest only when the debtor in default is not a consumer. The rule on this flat fee is not applicable against a consumer.

no_fee_for_card_or_sepa_payment.title: Shops may not charge extra for paying by SEPA direct debit, bank transfer or card
no_fee_for_card_or_sepa_payment.summary: An agreement that obliges the debtor to pay a fee for using a SEPA basic direct debit, SEPA company direct debit, SEPA transfer or a payment card is void.
keywords: shop charges fee paying by card

unusual_terms_not_binding_doubt_against_.title: Unusual small-print clauses do not count, and doubts are read against the company that wrote them
unusual_terms_not_binding_doubt_against_.summary: Terms in general conditions that are so unusual by the circumstances, especially by the look of the contract, that the other party need not expect them, do not become part of the contract. Doubts in interpreting general conditions go against the party that uses them.
keywords: hidden clause terms and conditions unusual
small print surprise clause not valid

invalid_clause_contract_survives.title: If a clause in the terms is void, the rest of the contract stays valid and the statute fills the gap
invalid_clause_contract_survives.summary: If general conditions are not part of the contract or are invalid, the contract otherwise remains in force. The content then follows the statutory rules.
keywords: what if one clause is illegal

no_liability_waiver_for_injury_in_terms.title: Small print cannot exclude liability for injuries to life, body or health
no_liability_waiver_for_injury_in_terms.summary: In general terms, a clause is invalid that excludes or limits liability for damage from injury to life, body or health caused by negligent breach by the user of the terms, or by intentional or negligent breach by his legal representative or helper. Limits for gross fault are also covered by the same rule.

no_contract_penalty_in_terms_for_late_pa.title: Terms cannot promise the company a contract penalty if you pay late, do not accept or leave the contract
no_contract_penalty_in_terms_for_late_pa.summary: A clause in general terms is invalid if it promises the user a contract penalty for non-acceptance or late acceptance of the service, for default in payment, or for the other party withdrawing from the contract.
keywords: penalty if i cancel terms conditions

terms_cannot_waive_reminder_or_deadline.title: Terms cannot let a company skip the reminder or deadline it must normally give you
terms_cannot_waive_reminder_or_deadline.summary: A clause in general terms is invalid that frees the user from the legal duty to send a reminder to the other party or to set a deadline for performance or later fulfilment.

withdraw_from_contract_after_deadline_fo.title: Withdrawing from a contract for poor performance: set a reasonable deadline first, unless exceptions apply
withdraw_from_contract_after_deadline_fo.summary: If the other side does not perform or performs badly, you can withdraw after setting a reasonable deadline without success. The deadline is not needed if the debtor seriously and finally refuses, or if special circumstances justify immediate withdrawal. No withdrawal is possible if the breach is insignificant.
keywords: withdraw from contract bad performance deadline

distance_contract_definition.title: A distance contract is concluded only through remote means such as email, phone or messages
distance_contract_definition.summary: A distance contract is one where the trader and the consumer use only means of distance communication for negotiations and conclusion, unless the contract is not concluded within an organised distance sales system. Means include letters, catalogues, phone calls, emails, text messages, broadcast and digital services.

online_shop_info_becomes_contract.title: What the shop tells you before you buy online becomes part of the contract
online_shop_info_becomes_contract.summary: In distance and off-premises contracts, the trader must inform the consumer as required by Article 246a of the introductory act. The information given becomes part of the contract unless the parties expressly agree otherwise.

webshop_must_let_you_fix_input_errors.title: Online shops must let you spot and fix input errors, confirm your order and save the terms
webshop_must_let_you_fix_input_errors.summary: A trader who sells online must give appropriate technical means to recognise and correct input errors before the order is placed, state the required information in time, confirm receipt of the order without delay by electronic means, and make it possible to retrieve and save the contract terms including the general conditions at conclusion.

digital_products_consumer_scope.title: Consumer rules for apps, downloads and online services apply when you pay a price, including digital value
digital_products_consumer_scope.summary: The special rules for digital products apply to consumer contracts under which a trader provides digital content or digital services for a price. A price also includes a digital representation of value. Digital content means data created and supplied in digital form.

claims_expire_three_years_end_of_year.title: Ordinary claims expire after three years, counted from the end of the year you knew about them
claims_expire_three_years_end_of_year.summary: The regular limitation period is three years. It starts at the end of the year in which the claim arose and the creditor learned, or without gross negligence should have learned, of the circumstances and of the debtor.
keywords: when does a debt become time barred

injury_claims_limit_thirty_years.title: Damages for injury to life, body, health or freedom expire only after 30 years at the latest
injury_claims_limit_thirty_years.summary: Damages claims based on injury to life, body, health or freedom expire, regardless of when they arose and of knowledge, 30 years after the act, breach of duty or other event that caused the damage.
keywords: how long can i claim for injury

negotiations_pause_limitation.title: While you negotiate about a claim, the limitation period is paused, with three extra months afterwards
negotiations_pause_limitation.summary: If debtor and creditor negotiate about the claim or the circumstances behind it, limitation is suspended until one side refuses to continue. Limitation then occurs at the earliest three months after the suspension ends.

lawsuit_or_payment_order_stops_limitatio.title: A lawsuit or a delivered payment order (Mahnbescheid) pauses the limitation period
lawsuit_or_payment_order_stops_limitatio.summary: Limitation is suspended by filing a lawsuit for performance or for a declaration of the claim, and by service of a payment order in the dunning procedure or of a European payment order.
keywords: how to stop claim from expiring

minor_contracts_need_parent_consent.title: Under 18: contracts need your parents' consent, otherwise they depend on their approval
minor_contracts_need_parent_consent.summary: A minor from seven years old has limited capacity to contract. For a declaration that is not merely legally advantageous, he needs the consent of his legal representative. keywords: can a 16 year old sign a contract

pocket_money_paragraph.title: A minor's contract is valid from the start if paid with money given for that purpose or free use
pocket_money_paragraph.summary: A contract that a minor made without the representative's consent is treated as valid from the beginning if the minor performs it with means that the representative, or a third party with his consent, left to him for that purpose or for free disposal.
keywords: minor buys with pocket money valid

child_liability_age_limits.title: Children and damage: under 7 not liable, 7 to 9 not in motor accidents, under 18 only with the insight to understand
child_liability_age_limits.summary: A child under seven is not responsible for damage to others. A child aged seven to nine is not responsible for damage in an accident with a motor vehicle, rail or suspension railway unless he caused it intentionally. Anyone under 18 is not responsible if, at the time of the act, he lacked the insight needed to recognise responsibility.

own_fault_reduces_damages.title: If you share the blame, your damages are reduced, also when you fail to limit the damage
own_fault_reduces_damages.summary: If the injured person's own fault contributed to the damage, the duty to pay and the amount depend on the circumstances, especially on who mainly caused it. The same applies if he failed to warn about an unusually high risk of damage or failed to avert or reduce the damage.

compensation_for_pain_only_where_law_all.title: Money for non-material harm can be claimed only in cases the law provides for
compensation_for_pain_only_where_law_all.summary: Compensation in money for damage that is not financial loss can be demanded only in the cases determined by law.
keywords: when can i claim pain and suffering

damages_restore_or_pay_money.title: Damages: restore the original state, or for injury and damaged property demand the money needed
damages_restore_or_pay_money.summary: Whoever must pay damages has to restore the state that would exist without the harmful event. keywords: compensation repair costs vat damaged item

animal_keeper_liable_for_damage.title: If an animal injures someone or damages property, its keeper must pay for the damage
animal_keeper_liable_for_damage.summary: If an animal kills or injures a person or damages property, the person who keeps the animal has to compensate the injured person for the resulting damage.

avoid_contract_for_deceit_or_threat.title: Tricked or threatened into a contract: you can avoid it, up to ten years at most
avoid_contract_for_deceit_or_threat.summary: Anyone who was led to make a declaration by fraudulent deception or unlawfully by a threat can avoid the declaration. Avoidance is excluded when ten years have passed since the declaration was made.
keywords: contract signed under pressure threat void

avoid_contract_for_mistake_quickly.title: Mistake about what you declared: you can avoid it, but you must act without undue delay
avoid_contract_for_mistake_quickly.summary: Someone who was mistaken about the content of his declaration, or did not want to make a declaration of that content at all, can avoid it if he would not have made it knowing the facts and judging sensibly. In these cases the avoidance must be made without culpable delay after learning the reason.
keywords: mistake in contract typo price avoid

applicants_count_as_employees_for_data_l.title: Job applicants and former employees count as "employees" under German employee data protection
applicants_count_as_employees_for_data_l.summary: For the employee data rules in the BDSG, applicants for a job and people whose employment has ended also count as employees, so their data may be processed only as far as needed for the hiring decision.

employer_data_only_if_needed_for_job.title: Employers may process your data only if needed to hire you, run or end the job, or meet legal duties
employer_data_only_if_needed_for_job.summary: Personal data of employees may be processed for employment purposes only where necessary for the decision to hire, or afterwards for carrying out or ending the employment, or to meet rights and duties set by law or collective agreements.
keywords: what personal data may employer collect

employer_data_crime_suspicion_documented.title: Employer investigating a crime at work needs documented concrete suspicion first
employer_data_crime_suspicion_documented.summary: To detect crimes, an employer may process employee data only if documented facts give rise to a suspicion that the person committed a crime in the employment relationship, the processing is necessary and not disproportionate.
keywords: employer investigating theft by employee data

employee_consent_form_and_voluntariness.title: Consent at work must be voluntary and in writing or electronic form
employee_consent_form_and_voluntariness.summary: Whether consent of an employee is voluntary depends on the dependency in the employment and the circumstances. It may be voluntary if it brings a legal or economic advantage or if both sides pursue the same interests. It must be in writing or electronic form unless special circumstances make another form appropriate.
keywords: employer asks me to consent photo data

krankengeld_when_unfit_for_work.title: Statutory insured people get Krankengeld when illness makes them unable to work
krankengeld_when_unfit_for_work.summary: Insured persons are entitled to sickness benefit (Krankengeld) if illness makes them unfit for work.
keywords: sick pay from health insurance after six weeks
when does the health fund pay krankengeld

krankengeld_abroad_with_fund_consent.title: Krankengeld keeps being paid abroad if your health fund agreed to the stay
krankengeld_abroad_with_fund_consent.summary: The claim to sickness benefit does not rest while an insured person stays abroad after becoming unfit for work, provided the health fund agreed to the stay.
keywords: krankenkasse agreed stay abroad sickness benefit

preventive_care_entitlement.title: Statutory insured people can get medical prevention care when health is weakening or a child's development is at risk
preventive_care_entitlement.summary: Insured persons are entitled to medical treatment and to medicines, dressings, remedies and aids that are necessary to strengthen health that is weakened and would likely lead to illness, to counter a risk to a child's health development, to prevent illness or its worsening, or to avoid the need for care.

fare_evasion_is_a_crime.title: Riding without a ticket on purpose is a crime: up to one year in prison or a fine
fare_evasion_is_a_crime.summary: Anyone who obtains transport by a means of transport, or entry to an event or facility, intending not to pay the fee, is punished with up to one year in prison or a fine. Attempt is punishable too.

misleading_ads_unfair.title: Misleading advertising about price, features or availability is unfair competition
misleading_ads_unfair.summary: A misleading commercial practice is unfair if it can make the consumer take a decision he would not otherwise have taken. It covers false information about main features, availability, benefits, risks and the price or how it is calculated.

price_cut_ads_burden_of_proof.title: Advertised price cut: if disputed, the shop must prove it really charged the old price
price_cut_ads_burden_of_proof.summary: If it is disputed whether and for how long the old price was demanded, the burden of proof lies with whoever advertised the price reduction.

insolvency_application_needs_discharge_r.title: Debt discharge (Restschuldbefreiung) only happens if you apply for it, ideally with the insolvency application
insolvency_application_needs_discharge_r.summary: Discharge of remaining debts requires an application by the debtor, which should be joined with the application to open insolvency proceedings. If it is filed separately, it must be submitted within two weeks after the court's notice.
keywords: how to get debts discharged germany application

insolvency_discharge_blocked_if_recent.title: No new debt discharge if you got one in the last 11 years or lost one for misconduct in the last 5
insolvency_discharge_blocked_if_recent.summary: An application for discharge is inadmissible if the debtor was granted discharge in the last eleven years before the insolvency application, or was refused it under § 297 in the last five years.
keywords: how long wait before another debt discharge

consumer_insolvency_application_contents.title: Consumer insolvency application: you must hand in lists of assets, income, creditors and debts
consumer_insolvency_application_contents.summary: The debtor's application must include the discharge request or a statement that none is sought, a list of assets and income with a summary, a list of creditors and a list of claims against him, with a declaration that the information is correct and complete.
keywords: what documents for personal insolvency germany

creditors_must_list_their_claims_on_requ.title: Creditors must give you a written statement of their claims for your insolvency application, at their cost
creditors_must_list_their_claims_on_requ.summary: When the debtor asks, creditors are obliged to give him, at their own cost, a written statement of their claims against him to prepare the list of claims.
keywords: creditor must provide statement of debt insolvency

work_costs_deduct_as_werbungskosten.title: Costs of earning income count as Werbungskosten and reduce your taxable income
work_costs_deduct_as_werbungskosten.summary: Werbungskosten are expenses to acquire, secure and preserve income. They are deducted in the income category in which they arise. They include the costs of trips between home and the first place of work.
keywords: which work expenses deduct tax germany

employee_flat_deduction_1230.title: Employees get a flat Werbungskosten allowance of 1,230 euro without receipts
employee_flat_deduction_1230.summary: For income from employment, a flat employee allowance (Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag) of 1,230 euro is deducted automatically; itemising only pays off if your costs are higher.
keywords: do I need receipts for small work expenses

agg_lawsuit_three_months_after_written_c.title: Discrimination at work: sue within three months after you made the written claim
agg_lawsuit_three_months_after_written_c.summary: A lawsuit for compensation under § 15 AGG must be filed within three months after the claim was asserted in writing.
keywords: discrimination compensation lawsuit deadline labor court
file suit after written claim agg

agg_employer_pays_damage_unless_not_resp.title: If the employer discriminates, it must repay your financial damage unless it is not responsible for the breach
agg_employer_pays_damage_unless_not_resp.summary: In case of a breach of the ban on discrimination the employer must compensate the damage caused, unless it is not responsible for the breach of duty.

agg_collective_agreement_intent_needed.title: If the employer only applied a collective agreement, compensation needs intent or gross negligence
agg_collective_agreement_intent_needed.summary: When applying collective agreements, the employer owes compensation only if it acts intentionally or with gross negligence.

traffic_accident_report_within_two_month.title: Traffic accident damage: tell the liable party within two months or lose the claim
traffic_accident_report_within_two_month.summary: The injured party loses the rights under the Road Traffic Act if he does not report the accident to the liable person within two months of learning of the damage and who is liable. registration_stay_up_to_six_months.title: Already registered in Germany and staying somewhere else up to six months: no new registration needed
registration_stay_up_to_six_months.summary: Anyone registered in Germany who moves into another residence for a stay of no more than six months does not have to register or deregister there. If the stay lasts longer than six months, registration within two weeks is required.

do i register for a short stay germany

registration_hotel_stay_over_six_months.title: Living in a hotel or hostel for more than six months: you must register
registration_hotel_stay_over_six_months.summary: People taken in by accommodation businesses (Beherbergungsstätten) for longer than six months are subject to the registration duty. Someone not registered for a home in Germany must register within two weeks once the stay exceeds three months.

hotel long stay anmeldung drei monate

registration_children_under_16.title: Children under 16: the people whose home they move into or out of do the registration
registration_children_under_16.summary: Registration and deregistration of persons under 16 is the duty of those in whose home the children move in or from whose home they move out. Newborns born in Germany need registration only if they move into a different home than their parents'.

teaching_small_works_in_full.title: For teaching, images, single journal articles and small or out-of-print works may be used in full
teaching_small_works_in_full.summary: Abbildungen, individual contributions from the same specialist or scientific journal, other works of small scope and out-of-print works may be used in full for illustrating teaching, in derogation from the 15 percent limit.
keywords: teacher share whole article journal course
out of print work teaching full

private_copies_may_not_be_shared.title: Copies made for private or own use may not be distributed or used in public performances
private_copies_may_not_be_shared.summary: Copies made under the private and personal use exceptions may be neither distributed nor used for public performances.
keywords: private copy share with friends allowed

payment_not_executed_full_refund.title: Transfer you ordered failed or went wrong: your bank must refund the full amount without delay
payment_not_executed_full_refund.summary: If a payment you initiated was not executed or was executed incorrectly, you can demand that your payment service provider refunds the amount immediately and in full.

payment_provider_liability_cap_12500.title: Other damage from a failed transfer can be capped at 12,500 euro, but not for intent or gross negligence
payment_provider_liability_cap_12500.summary: Beyond the refund rules, the provider's liability for damage caused by a payment order that was not executed, wrongly executed or late can be limited to 12,500 euro. This limit does not apply to intent.

report_unauthorised_payment_without_dela.title: Spot a payment you did not authorise or that went wrong: tell your bank immediately
report_unauthorised_payment_without_dela.summary: A payment service user must inform the provider without undue delay after discovering an unauthorised or wrongly executed payment.
keywords: how fast report wrong payment bank

new_provider_cancel_needs_text_form.title: If a new provider cancels your old contract for you, your cancellation or authorisation needs text form
new_provider_cancel_needs_text_form.summary: If a business, after you changed provider, is commissioned to pass on your cancellation of an existing continuing contract or is authorised to declare it, your cancellation or the authorisation needs text form (for example email).

cancel_button_not_for_finance_or_strict_.title: The cancel button duty does not cover financial services or contracts that need a stricter form than text form
cancel_button_not_for_finance_or_strict_.summary: The online cancellation button duty applies to web contracts for continuing obligations with paid service. contract_basis_collapsed_adjust_or_leave.title: If the basis of a contract collapses, you can demand adjustment, and if that is impossible, withdraw or terminate
contract_basis_collapsed_adjust_or_leave.summary: If circumstances that became the basis of the contract change seriously, or essential assumptions turn out to be false, adjustment can be demanded. student_benefit_exception_no_baf_g_claim.title: Students with no BAföG claim for specific reasons are not shut out of Grundsicherung by the study exclusion
student_benefit_exception_no_baf_g_claim.summary: The exclusion in § 7 Abs. 5 SGB II does not apply to trainees who have no right to training support because of § 2 Abs. 1a BAföG. § 7 Abs. 6 lists further exceptions for trainees whose needs are measured under certain BAföG provisions.

exception student citizens benefit not exclude

wohngeld_excluded_with_grundsicherung.title: No Wohngeld if you receive Grundsicherungsgeld or trainee benefits paid as a grant under § 27 SGB II
wohngeld_excluded_with_grundsicherung.summary: Recipients of Grundsicherungsgeld under SGB II, and recipients of benefits for trainees under § 27 Abs. 3 SGB II that are paid as a grant, are excluded from housing benefit.

can i get wohngeld and jobcenter

usury_contract_void.title: Exploitative deals (usury) are void: obvious imbalance plus exploiting your weakness, inexperience or hardship
usury_contract_void.summary: A legal transaction is void if someone, by exploiting the other's predicament, inexperience, lack of judgment or considerable weakness of will, has promised or granted to himself or a third party financial advantages that are in obvious disproportion to the performance.

contract_against_good_morals_void.title: A contract that offends common decency (gute Sitten) is void
contract_against_good_morals_void.summary: A legal transaction that violates good morals is void.

contract_against_statutory_ban_void.title: A contract that breaks a legal prohibition is void unless the law says otherwise
contract_against_statutory_ban_void.summary: A legal transaction that violates a statutory prohibition is void, unless the law provides otherwise.

void_clause_whole_contract_void_unless.title: If one part of a deal is void, the whole deal is void unless it would have been made without that part
void_clause_whole_contract_void_unless.summary: If part of a legal transaction is void, the whole transaction is void, unless it can be assumed that it would have been made without the void part.

void_deal_may_count_as_another.title: A void deal counts as another deal if it meets that deal's requirements and the parties would have wanted it
void_deal_may_count_as_another.summary: If a void legal transaction meets the requirements of another legal transaction, the latter applies if it can be assumed that the parties would have wanted it had they known of the nullity.

unordered_goods_exception_mistaken_deliv.title: Unordered goods: legal claims stay possible if it was a mistaken delivery you recognised or should have recognised
unordered_goods_exception_mistaken_deliv.summary: Legal claims are not excluded if the item was not meant for the recipient or was delivered under the mistaken idea of an order, and the recipient recognised this or could have recognised it with the care required in business.

parcel delivered by mistake keep it

unordered_goods_terms_cannot_waive.title: Shops cannot change the unordered goods rule to your disadvantage, even by tricks

no contract from silence germany consumer

important_reason_dismissal_give_reason_i.title: Fired for an important reason: you can demand the reason in writing, and it must come without delay
important_reason_dismissal_give_reason_i.summary: The person who gives notice for an important reason must, on request, tell the other side the reason for the termination in writing without delay.

ask employer for dismissal reason germany

continuing_contract_important_reason_no_.title: Any ongoing contract can be ended without notice for an important reason
continuing_contract_important_reason_no_.summary: Each party can terminate a continuing obligation for an important reason without observing a notice period. terminate subscription lease service contract early unreasonable

parttime_request_employer_must_discuss.title: Asked to cut your hours: your employer must discuss it with you and aim for an agreement
parttime_request_employer_must_discuss.summary: The employer has to discuss the desired reduction of working time with the employee with the aim of reaching an agreement, and has to reach agreement with the employee on how the working time is distributed.

parttime_request_refusal_grounds.title: The employer may refuse a part-time request only for operational reasons, such as serious disruption or disproportionate cost

parttime_request_decision_one_month_befo.title: The employer must answer your part-time request in text form at least one month before the start, or your wishes may apply

bridge_part_time_needs_over_45_staff.summary: An employee has a right to a temporary reduction of working time only if the employer usually employs more than 45 employees.
keywords: temporary part time small company no right

bridge_part_time_quota_45_to_200.title: Employers with 46 to 200 staff may refuse Brückenteilzeit once enough colleagues already have it
bridge_part_time_quota_45_to_200.summary: An employer with usually more than 45 but not more than 200 employees can also refuse a request if, at the desired start, a quota of employees already works reduced hours: at least four for more than 45 to 60 employees, five for more than 60 to 75, six for more than 75 to 90, seven for more than 90 to 105 employees, and so on.
keywords: temporary part time refused quota colleagues

care_emergency_ten_days_off.title: A relative suddenly needs care: you may stay away from work up to ten working days
care_emergency_ten_days_off.summary: Employees have the right to stay away from work for up to ten working days if this is necessary to organise appropriate care or ensure care for a close relative in need of care in an acute care situation.
keywords: sudden care situation relative days off work
take time off to organise care for parent

care_emergency_tell_employer_certificate.title: Care emergency: tell your employer at once how long you will be away and show a certificate if asked
care_emergency_tell_employer_certificate.summary: Employees must inform the employer without delay of their absence and its expected duration. On request the employer must be shown a medical certificate or a certificate from a nursing professional on the relative's need for care and the necessity of the measures.

care_leave_not_for_tiny_employers.title: Up to six months of care leave (Pflegezeit) only against employers with more than 15 employees
care_leave_not_for_tiny_employers.summary: The right to be fully or partly released from work to care for a close relative at home (Pflegezeit) does not exist against employers who usually have 15 or fewer employees.
keywords: care leave small employer no right
company with ten employees care leave six months

care_leave_combined_24_months.title: Care leave plus family care leave together may not exceed 24 months per relative
care_leave_combined_24_months.summary: Pflegezeit and Familienpflegezeit together may not exceed a total of 24 months for each close relative in need of care.
keywords: how long can i take care leave

care_leave_dismissal_protection.title: Care leave: no dismissal from the announcement, at most twelve weeks before it starts
care_leave_dismissal_protection.summary: The employer may not terminate the employment from the announcement, but at most twelve weeks before the announced start, until the end of the short-term absence under § 2 or the release under § 3.
keywords: fired once i announce care leave

family_care_leave_min_15_hours.title: Family care leave: up to 24 months of reduced hours, at least 15 hours a week, only at employers with more than 25 staff
family_care_leave_min_15_hours.summary: Employees are partly released from work for up to 24 months to care for a close relative at home. The reduced weekly working time must be at least 15 hours, averaged over up to a year. The claim does not exist against employers who usually employ 25 or fewer employees, not counting trainees.

care_support_allowance_ten_days.title: During a care emergency absence you can get Pflegeunterstützungsgeld for up to ten working days a year
