care_support_allowance_ten_days.summary: Employees who take short-term leave under § 2 PflegeZG and get neither continued pay from the employer nor sickness benefit for a sick child have a claim to compensation for lost pay (Pflegeunterstützungsgeld) for up to ten working days per calendar year. If several employees claim for the same relative, the total is limited to ten days.
keywords: care support allowance lost pay care emergency
who pays during care leave days
money while away sudden care situation

employer_must_protect_life_and_health_61.title: The employer must arrange workplace, equipment and work so you are protected against danger to life and health
employer_must_protect_life_and_health_61.summary: The employer must set up and maintain the rooms, devices and equipment he has to provide, and regulate services under his direction, so that the employee is protected against danger to life and health as far as the nature of the service permits.
keywords: employer duty of care safe workplace

minijob_hours_must_be_recorded.title: Minijob: your employer must record start, end and length of each workday within seven days and keep it two years
minijob_hours_must_be_recorded.summary: Employers of marginally employed workers (minijobbers) must record the start, end and duration of the daily working time at the latest by the end of the seventh calendar day after the work and keep the records for at least two years.
keywords: minijob employer must record working hours
keep time records two years minijob

miscarriage_protection_eight_weeks_from_.title: After a miscarriage from the 20th week of pregnancy, the maternity protection period lasts eight weeks
miscarriage_protection_eight_weeks_from_.summary: The protection period after a miscarriage lasts six weeks from the 17th week of pregnancy and eight weeks from the 20th week of pregnancy.

wisszeitvg_six_years_before_phd.title: University research staff without a doctorate: fixed-term contracts allowed up to six years in total
wisszeitvg_six_years_before_phd.summary: Fixed-term employment contracts of scientific and artistic staff who have not completed a doctorate are allowed for up to six years if the temporary employment serves their own scientific or artistic qualification.
keywords: fixed term research assistant six years germany

wisszeitvg_counts_all_earlier_university.title: For the six-year limit, all earlier fixed-term jobs at German universities over a quarter of full time count
wisszeitvg_counts_all_earlier_university.summary: All earlier fixed-term employment with a German university or research institution of more than a quarter of the regular working time, and comparable civil-service and private service contracts, count towards the permitted fixed-term duration.
keywords: wisszeitvg anrechnung befristete verträge viertel arbeitszeit
which previous contracts count six year limit
earlier research jobs count fixed term limit

inheritance_passes_automatically_but_can.title: An inheritance passes to the heir automatically, but he can refuse it
inheritance_passes_automatically_but_can.summary: The estate passes to the called heir by operation of law, without prejudice to the right to disclaim it. The state, as statutory heir, cannot disclaim.
keywords: do i have to accept inheritance germany

inheritance_refusal_within_six_weeks.title: You can disclaim an inheritance only within six weeks
inheritance_refusal_within_six_weeks.summary: The disclaimer of an inheritance can only be made within six weeks.

inheritance_deadline_starts_with_knowled.title: The six weeks start when you know about the inheritance and why you are heir, not before the court announces a will
inheritance_deadline_starts_with_knowled.summary: The period starts when the heir learns of the inheritance and the reason for his calling. If the heir is called by a will or inheritance contract, the period does not start before the probate court announces it.
keywords: when do six weeks inheritance start

inheritance_accepted_when_deadline_passe.title: Miss the deadline or accept the inheritance and you can no longer refuse it
inheritance_accepted_when_deadline_passe.summary: The heir can no longer disclaim the inheritance once he has accepted it or once the prescribed period has passed; when the period expires the inheritance is deemed accepted.
keywords: accepted inheritance by mistake can refuse

inheritance_contest_acceptance_six_weeks.title: If acceptance or disclaimer of an inheritance can be contested, you have six weeks
inheritance_contest_acceptance_six_weeks.summary: If the acceptance or the disclaimer of an inheritance can be avoided, the avoidance can be declared only within six weeks.
keywords: erbschaft anfechten sechs wochen annahme ausschlagung

fine_notice_objection_two_weeks.title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid): you have two weeks after delivery to object in writing
fine_notice_objection_two_weeks.summary: The person concerned can object to a fine notice within two weeks of service, in writing or recorded at the authority that issued it.

fine_notice_objection_can_be_limited.title: You can limit your objection to a fine notice to certain points
fine_notice_objection_can_be_limited.summary: The objection to a fine notice can be limited to specific points of complaint.

fine_notice_warns_of_worse_decision.title: A fine notice must warn you that it becomes final without objection and that an objection can lead to a worse decision
fine_notice_warns_of_worse_decision.summary: The fine notice must state that it becomes final and enforceable if no objection under § 67 is filed, and that after an objection a decision less favourable to the person concerned can also be made.
keywords: objection fine can make it worse
fine notice becomes final no objection

authority_decision_objection_one_month.title: Authority decision (Verwaltungsakt): file your objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification
authority_decision_objection_one_month.summary: The objection must be raised within one month after the administrative act was announced to the person affected, in writing, in electronic form, or recorded at the authority that issued it.
keywords: object to authority decision deadline germany

objection_clock_needs_correct_instructio.title: The objection period only starts if the notice tells you how, where and by when to object
objection_clock_needs_correct_instructio.summary: The period for an appeal or other remedy only starts to run if the party was informed in writing or electronically about the remedy, the authority or court where it must be filed, its seat and the deadline.

missing_appeal_instruction_one_year.title: If the appeal instruction was missing or wrong, you have one year
missing_appeal_instruction_one_year.summary: If the instruction was omitted or wrongly given, the remedy can only be filed within one year of service, notification or announcement, unless filing within the year was impossible through force majeure or a written instruction said no remedy exists.

lawsuit_one_month_after_objection_decisi.title: After the objection is rejected, sue within one month of service of the decision
lawsuit_one_month_after_objection_decisi.summary: An action to annul an administrative act must be filed within one month after service of the objection decision.

deadline_missed_apply_within_two_weeks.title: Missed an authority or court deadline through no fault of yours: apply for reinstatement within two weeks
deadline_missed_apply_within_two_weeks.summary: The application for reinstatement must be filed within two weeks after the obstacle ceases; for missed deadlines to justify certain appeals the period is one month.

legal_aid_court_conditions.title: Court cost aid (Prozesskostenhilfe): if you cannot pay, and the case has enough chance and is not frivolous
legal_aid_court_conditions.summary: A party who, given his personal and economic circumstances, cannot pay the costs of litigation at all, only in part or only in instalments receives Prozesskostenhilfe on application if the intended claim or defence has sufficient prospects of success.
keywords: court costs help low income germany

legal_aid_court_use_assets.title: For Prozesskostenhilfe you must use your assets where that is reasonable
legal_aid_court_use_assets.summary: The party has to use his assets as far as this is reasonable; § 90 SGB XII applies accordingly.

legal_aid_court_not_if_cheap.title: No Prozesskostenhilfe if the litigation costs would not exceed four monthly instalments
legal_aid_court_not_if_cheap.summary: Prozesskostenhilfe is not granted if the costs of litigation are expected not to exceed four monthly instalments and the amounts to be paid from assets.

legal_advice_aid_conditions.title: Advice aid (Beratungshilfe): you cannot pay, no other help is reasonable, and it is not frivolous
legal_advice_aid_conditions.summary: Help for exercising rights outside court proceedings is granted on application if the person seeking advice cannot raise the necessary means, no other reasonable help is available, and using the aid does not appear frivolous.

legal_advice_aid_not_during_court_case.title: Advice aid only if no court case is running or was run in the same matter
legal_advice_aid_not_during_court_case.summary: Advice aid can only be granted if no court proceeding was or is being conducted in the same matter, which the applicant must expressly affirm. Someone who wants representation in court proceedings can get Prozesskostenhilfe instead.
keywords: advice aid unavailable if lawsuit running
legal advice form same matter court

speed_limit_50_in_town.title: Inside built-up areas the maximum speed for all motor vehicles is 50 km/h
speed_limit_50_in_town.summary: Even under the best conditions, the permitted maximum speed inside closed built-up areas is 50 km/h for all motor vehicles, unless a sign allows more.
keywords: how fast can i drive in city germany

drive_to_stop_within_sight.title: You may only drive so fast that you can stop within the distance you can see
drive_to_stop_within_sight.summary: A driver may only go so fast that the vehicle is always under control, and the speed must fit the road, traffic, visibility and weather. You may only drive so fast that you can stop within the visible stretch.
keywords: speed must match weather road visibility
drive on sight stopping distance germany

fog_snow_rain_under_50_metres_visibility.title: If fog, snow or rain limits visibility to under 50 m, do not drive faster than 50 km/h
fog_snow_rain_under_50_metres_visibility.summary: If visibility through fog, snowfall or rain is less than 50 m, you must not drive faster than 50 km/h unless an even lower speed is required.

snow_chains_speed_limit_50.title: With snow chains the maximum speed is 50 km/h
snow_chains_speed_limit_50.summary: The permitted top speed for motor vehicles with snow chains is 50 km/h even under the best conditions.

debtor_in_default_after_reminder.title: A debtor who does not pay after a reminder (Mahnung) after the due date is in default
debtor_in_default_after_reminder.summary: If the debtor does not perform after a reminder from the creditor that comes after the performance is due, he is in default through the reminder. A lawsuit or a served payment order counts like a reminder.
keywords: when am i in default payment germany
lawsuit or payment order counts as reminder

default_without_reminder_cases.title: No reminder is needed if a calendar date was agreed or the debtor seriously refuses to pay
default_without_reminder_cases.summary: A reminder is unnecessary if a time was set by the calendar, if an event must come first and a reasonable time after it can be counted from the calendar, if the debtor seriously and finally refuses, or if special reasons justify immediate default.
keywords: payment date fixed default without reminder

liability_stricter_during_default.title: While in default you are liable for any negligence and even for chance events
liability_stricter_during_default.summary: During default the debtor is liable for every negligence and also for chance regarding the performance, unless the damage would have happened even with timely performance.

package_tour_withdraw_any_time_before_st.title: You can withdraw from a package tour at any time before it starts, but the operator can demand reasonable compensation
package_tour_withdraw_any_time_before_st.summary: Before the trip starts the traveller can withdraw from the contract at any time. The operator then loses the claim to the agreed price but can demand reasonable compensation.

package_tour_cancellation_fee_calculatio.title: Cancellation flat fees must be reasonable; without them it is the price minus savings and re-use
package_tour_cancellation_fee_calculatio.summary: The contract can set reasonable flat compensation, based on the time between withdrawal and start, expected savings of the operator and expected income from using the services otherwise. Without flat rates the compensation is the trip price minus the operator's saved expenses and what he earns by other use.
keywords: cancellation fee package tour how calculated

package_tour_transfer_to_other_traveller.title: You can let another person take over your package tour; a notice up to seven days before the start is always in time
package_tour_transfer_to_other_traveller.summary: Within a reasonable period before the start the traveller can declare on a durable medium that a third party takes over his rights and duties; the declaration is in any case in time if it reaches the operator no later than seven days before the start.
keywords: transfer holiday booking to another person

package_tour_terminate_for_serious_defec.title: If a defect seriously impairs the package tour, you can terminate the contract
package_tour_terminate_for_serious_defec.summary: If the package tour is considerably impaired by a travel defect, the traveller can terminate the contract.

right_to_social_benefit_advice.title: Everyone has a right to advice on their rights and duties under social law, from the responsible agency
right_to_social_benefit_advice.summary: Everyone is entitled to advice about his rights and duties under the Social Code. The benefit providers to whom the rights are to be asserted or the duties performed are responsible for the advice.
keywords: right to advice social benefits germany

disability_definition_six_months.title: "Disabled" means impairments that, with barriers, may hinder equal participation for likely more than six months
disability_definition_six_months.summary: People with disabilities have physical, mental, intellectual or sensory impairments that, in interaction with attitude- and environment-related barriers, can very probably hinder equal participation in society for longer than six months. An impairment exists if the bodily and health state differs from what is typical for the age.
keywords: menschen mit behinderungen begriff sgb ix

severe_disability_gdb_50.title: You count as severely disabled with a degree of disability (GdB) of at least 50
severe_disability_gdb_50.summary: People are severely disabled in the sense of part 3 if they have a degree of disability of at least 50 and live, usually reside or are employed in Germany.

gdb_scale_ten_to_hundred.title: The degree of disability (GdB) is graded in tens from 10 to 100
gdb_scale_ten_to_hundred.summary: The degree of disability (GdB) gives the impairment of participation in steps of ten from 10 to 100, regardless of the cause of the health disorder.

insurance_contract_withdrawal_14_days.title: Insurance contracts: withdraw within 14 days in text form, without giving reasons
insurance_contract_withdrawal_14_days.summary: The policyholder can withdraw his declaration within 14 days. The withdrawal must be in text form to the insurer, needs no reasons, and sending it in time is enough. The right ends at the latest twelve months and 14 days after the contract was concluded.

consumer_building_contract_withdrawal.title: For consumer building contracts the withdrawal period only starts after proper instruction
consumer_building_contract_withdrawal.summary: For a consumer building contract the withdrawal period does not begin before the contractor has instructed the consumer about the right of withdrawal. The right ends at the latest twelve months and 14 days after the start of the period.

social_authority_decision_must_be_specif.title: A social-law decision (Verwaltungsakt) must be clear enough in its content
social_authority_decision_must_be_specif.summary: An administrative act under social law must be sufficiently specific in its content, so the person affected can tell what is decided.

social_authority_decision_oral_confirm_i.title: An oral decision from a social agency must be confirmed in writing if you ask right away and have a legitimate interest
social_authority_decision_oral_confirm_i.summary: An administrative act can be issued in writing, electronically, orally or in another way. An oral act must be confirmed in writing or electronically if there is a legitimate interest and the person affected demands it without delay.
keywords: agency said it orally confirm in writing

social_decision_must_state_how_to_object.title: A social agency decision must tell you in writing where, by when and in what form to object
social_decision_must_state_how_to_object.summary: The authority must instruct in writing about the remedy, the place where it must be filed, the seat of that place, the deadline to observe and the form. An electronic decision needs an electronic instruction.

flat_special_expenses_36_euro.title: Special expenses (donations, church tax, own training etc.) get an automatic 36 euro flat deduction
flat_special_expenses_36_euro.summary: For special expenses under § 10 para 1 nos. 4, 5, 7 and 9 and para 1a and § 10b, a flat amount of 36 euros is deducted if you do not prove higher expenses.
keywords: special expenses flat rate germany tax

meal_allowance_28_euro_full_day.title: Meal allowance of 28 euros for each calendar day you are away 24 hours
meal_allowance_28_euro_full_day.summary: For each calendar day on which an employee is away from home and workplace for 24 hours, 28 euros can be claimed as a flat amount for extra meal costs.
keywords: per diem business trip tax germany

support_of_dependants_tax_relief.title: Supporting a person who is legally entitled to maintenance can reduce tax up to the basic allowance
support_of_dependants_tax_relief.summary: If you bear costs for the maintenance and any vocational training of a person who is legally entitled to support from you or your spouse, income tax is reduced on application by deducting the costs up to the amount of the basic tax-free allowance per calendar year.

theft_penalty.title: Theft: up to five years in prison or a fine, and the attempt is punishable
theft_penalty.summary: Whoever takes movable property belonging to another with the intent of unlawfully appropriating it for himself or a third party is punished with imprisonment up to five years or a fine. The attempt is punishable.

fraud_penalty.title: Fraud: up to five years in prison or a fine, and the attempt is punishable
fraud_penalty.summary: Whoever, intending to obtain an unlawful pecuniary advantage, damages another person's property by deceiving or maintaining a mistake through false facts is punished with imprisonment up to five years or a fine. The attempt is punishable, and serious cases carry six months to ten years.

computer_fraud_and_tools.title: Computer fraud covers manipulated data processing; preparing it with tools or passwords is punishable too
computer_fraud_and_tools.summary: Preparing computer fraud by making, obtaining, offering, keeping or passing on programs designed for it, or passwords or other security codes suited to it, is punished with imprisonment up to three years or a fine.

naturalisation_requires_self_support.title: Naturalisation: you must support yourself and your family without SGB II or SGB XII benefits, with exceptions
naturalisation_requires_self_support.summary: A foreigner is naturalised on application, among other conditions, if he can cover his living costs and those of his dependants without benefits under the Second or Twelfth Book of the Social Code; the law lists exceptions to this condition.
keywords: einbürgerung sgb ii sgb xii leistungen

naturalisation_identity_and_nationality_.title: Naturalisation needs clarified identity and nationality, plus lawful habitual residence
naturalisation_identity_and_nationality_.summary: A foreigner who has lawfully had his habitual residence in Germany for the required period, has legal capacity or a legal representative, and whose identity and nationality are clarified, is naturalised on application if he meets the further conditions.

naturalisation_confession_history_respon.title: Naturalisation requires a commitment to Germany's historical responsibility and peaceful coexistence
naturalisation_confession_history_respon.summary: The applicant must confess to Germany's special historical responsibility for the National Socialist tyranny and its consequences, especially the protection of Jewish life, and to the peaceful coexistence of peoples and the ban on wars of aggression.

risk_assessment_includes_mental_stress.title: The employer's risk assessment must also cover mental stress at work
risk_assessment_includes_mental_stress.summary: Hazards can arise, among other things, from mental stress at work. The employer has to assess the risks linked to each job, and for similar working conditions one assessment of a workplace or activity is enough.

works_council_decides_working_hours_layo.title: The works council co-decides start, end and breaks of the workday and temporary longer or shorter hours
works_council_decides_working_hours_layo.summary: Where no law or collective agreement regulates it, the works council has a right of co-determination on the start and end of daily working time including breaks and distribution over weekdays, and on temporary shortening or extension of the usual hours.
keywords: works council say in working hours

works_council_decides_pay_timing_and_lea.title: The works council co-decides when and where pay is paid and the general leave principles and plan
works_council_decides_pay_timing_and_lea.summary: The works council co-determines the time, place and manner of paying wages, and the general principles of leave, the leave plan and the timing of leave for individual employees if no agreement is reached with them.

works_council_decides_safety_rules.title: The works council co-decides rules on preventing accidents and occupational diseases and on health protection
works_council_decides_safety_rules.summary: The works council has a right of co-determination on rules for preventing work accidents and occupational diseases and for health protection within the legal framework and accident prevention rules.

works_council_conciliation_board_decides.title: If employer and works council cannot agree on a co-determination matter, a conciliation board decides
works_council_conciliation_board_decides.summary: If no agreement is reached on a matter under § 87 para 1, the conciliation board decides, and its ruling replaces the agreement between employer and works council.

works_council_hiring_information_duty.title: Before hiring or transferring you, the employer must tell the works council the job and the pay grade
works_council_hiring_information_duty.summary: For hirings and transfers the employer must in particular tell the works council the planned workplace and the intended grouping in the pay scheme.

works_council_can_refuse_hire_if_law_bro.title: The works council can refuse consent to a hire if it breaks a law, collective agreement or selection guideline
works_council_can_refuse_hire_if_law_bro.summary: The works council can refuse consent to a personnel measure if it would violate a law, regulation, accident prevention rule, collective agreement, works agreement, court decision or official order, if it violates a selection guideline under § 95, or if there is a well-founded concern that other employees would be dismissed or otherwise disadvantaged.

price_must_include_vat_total_price.title: Prices shown to consumers must be total prices including VAT and other price components
price_must_include_vat_total_price.summary: The total price (Gesamtpreis) is the price payable for a good or service including VAT and other price components. It must be stated to consumers, and if a price is broken down, the total price must be highlighted.
keywords: price must include vat germany consumer

unit_price_per_quantity.title: Goods need a unit price (per kg or litre) unless it equals the total price
unit_price_per_quantity.summary: Under the price-indication rules the basic price (Grundpreis) is the price per unit of quantity including VAT and other components. It can be left out if it is identical to the total price.

probationary_licence_two_years.title: A first driving licence is issued on probation for two years
probationary_licence_two_years.summary: When a driving licence is acquired for the first time it is granted on probation, and the probation period lasts two years from the issue date. For a holder of a foreign licence, the time since acquiring it counts towards the probation.

probationary_licence_clock_pauses_when_s.title: Seizing or provisionally withdrawing your licence pauses the probation clock
probationary_licence_clock_pauses_when_s.summary: Seizure, securing or custody of driving licences under § 94 StPO, provisional withdrawal under § 111a StPO and immediately enforceable withdrawal by the licence authority suspend the running of the probation period. The period ends early if the licence is withdrawn.

probationary_licence_seminar_order_in_wr.title: A driving seminar order for probationary drivers must be in writing, name the offences and set a deadline
probationary_licence_seminar_order_in_wr.summary: The order to attend a follow-up seminar (Aufbauseminar) under § 2a para 2 StVG is made in writing, states the traffic violations that led to it, and sets a reasonable deadline. The written order must be shown to the course leader at registration.

small_business_vat_waiver_five_years.title: Small-business VAT exemption: up to 25,000 euro prior year and 100,000 euro current year
small_business_vat_waiver_five_years.summary: A domestic business's supplies are VAT-exempt if its total turnover did not exceed 25,000 euros in the previous calendar year and does not exceed 100,000 euros in the current year. A waiver of the exemption binds the business for at least five calendar years.

phone_advertising_consent_must_be_docume.title: A company that cold-calls you must document your prior express consent
phone_advertising_consent_must_be_docume.summary: Whoever advertises to a consumer by phone must document the consumer's prior express consent at the time it is given, in an appropriate form, and keep it as the law requires.
keywords: cold call consent proof company must keep

ad_message_hiding_sender_is_nuisance.title: Advertising messages that hide who the sender is count as an unacceptable nuisance
ad_message_hiding_sender_is_nuisance.summary: An unacceptable nuisance is always assumed for advertising by a message where the identity of the sender on whose behalf it is sent is concealed or kept secret.

end_device_access_needs_informed_consent.title: Storing or reading data on your device (e.g. cookies) needs your consent after clear and full information
end_device_access_needs_informed_consent.summary: Storing information on a user's device or accessing information already stored there is only allowed if the user consented on the basis of clear and comprehensive information. Information and consent follow the GDPR.

strictly_necessary_cookies_no_consent.title: No consent needed if storage on your device is strictly necessary for a service you explicitly asked for
strictly_necessary_cookies_no_consent.summary: Consent is not required if the sole purpose is carrying out a transmission over a public telecommunications network, or if storing or accessing information is strictly necessary so the provider can supply a digital service the user explicitly requested.

company_housing_notice_shorter_when_need.title: Employer-provided housing: shorter landlord notice when the flat is needed for another employee
company_housing_notice_shorter_when_need.summary: For flats let because of employment, the landlord can give notice at the latest by the third working day of a month to the end of the month after next if the tenant had it for less than ten years and the flat is needed for another employee. If the job required housing near the workplace and it is needed for another employee for the same reason, notice by the third working day to the end of that month is allowed.

rent_brake_not_for_new_build_after_2014.title: The rent brake does not apply to flats first used and let after 1 October 2014 or first let after full modernisation
rent_brake_not_for_new_build_after_2014.summary: Section 556d is not applicable to a dwelling first used and let after 1 October 2014. §§ 556d and 556e do not apply to the first letting after comprehensive modernisation.
keywords: new flat rent cap exempt germany

rent_brake_previous_rent_allowed.title: If the previous tenant paid more than the capped rent, the landlord may ask up to that previous rent
rent_brake_previous_rent_allowed.summary: If the rent the previous tenant last owed (Vormiete) is higher than the rent allowed under § 556d para 1, a rent up to the amount of the previous rent may be agreed.
keywords: rent brake previous tenant rent higher

rent_brake_modernisation_exception.title: Modernisation in the last three years can justify rent above the capped limit
rent_brake_modernisation_exception.summary: If the landlord carried out modernisation measures within the three years before the tenancy began, the rent may exceed the capped limit under conditions set in § 556e para 2.

tax_assessment_objection_one_month.title: Tax assessment: file your objection (Einspruch) within one month of notification
tax_assessment_objection_one_month.summary: An objection against a tax administrative act must be filed within one month after the act was announced.

tax_return_due_seven_months_after_year.title: Tax return for a calendar year is due seven months after the year ends, unless the tax laws say otherwise
tax_return_due_seven_months_after_year.summary: Unless tax laws provide otherwise, returns for a calendar year are due at the latest seven months after the end of the calendar year. Returns prepared with a tax adviser follow a longer deadline.
keywords: when is tax return due germany

late_filing_surcharge_quarter_percent.title: Late tax return: surcharge of 0.25 percent of the tax per started month, at least 25 euros
late_filing_surcharge_quarter_percent.summary: For returns relating to a calendar year, the late-filing surcharge is 0.25 percent of the assessed tax for each started month of delay, and at least 25 euros per started month.

late_filing_surcharge_automatic_after_14.title: A late-filing surcharge is mandatory if the return is not filed within 14 months after the year
late_filing_surcharge_automatic_after_14.summary: A late-filing surcharge must be set if a return for a calendar year is not filed within 14 months after the end of the year, or if it is not filed by the date set in an order under § 149 para 4.

late_filing_surcharge_exceptions.title: No late-filing surcharge if the deadline was extended or the tax is set at zero or less
late_filing_surcharge_exceptions.summary: No surcharge is imposed if the tax office extended the filing deadline, if the tax is assessed at zero euros or a negative amount, or if the assessed tax does not exceed advance payments and withheld tax to be credited.
keywords: no late penalty refund tax return
tax refund late filing no surcharge

non_compete_needs_signed_written_documen.title: A post-employment non-compete needs written form and a signed copy handed to the employee
non_compete_needs_signed_written_documen.summary: An agreement that restricts the employee's business activity after the employment ends requires written form and a document signed by the employer containing the agreed terms, handed to the employee.
keywords: non compete written signed copy employee

non_compete_compensation_paid_monthly.title: Non-compete compensation must be paid at the end of each month
non_compete_compensation_paid_monthly.summary: The compensation owed to the employee for the non-compete period under § 74 para 2 must be paid at the end of each month.

payslip_not_needed_if_nothing_changed.title: The employer need not issue a new payslip if nothing changed since the last proper one
payslip_not_needed_if_nothing_changed.summary: The duty to give a pay statement does not apply if the details have not changed compared with the last proper statement.

extra_pay_certificate_on_request.title: You can ask your employer for an additional pay certificate for other purposes
extra_pay_certificate_on_request.summary: For other purposes than the social-law ones, the employee can demand a further pay certificate (Entgeltbescheinigung) limited to the details in the pay statement under paragraph 1.

minors_restaurants_rules.title: Under-16s in restaurants and pubs: only with a parent or guardian, or for a meal or drink between 5:00 and 23:00
minors_restaurants_rules.summary: Children and young people under 16 may only be allowed in restaurants if accompanied by a custodial or authorised person, or if they have a meal or drink between 5:00 and 23:00. Teenagers 16 and over may not stay without such accompaniment between 24:00 and 5:00.

minors_nightclub_not_allowed.title: Children and young people may not be admitted to night bars, nightclubs and similar venues
minors_nightclub_not_allowed.summary: Children and young people may not be allowed to stay in establishments run as night bars or nightclubs, or in comparable entertainment venues.

film_age_ratings_five_levels.title: Films and games carry one of five labels: no age limit, 6, 12, 16, or no youth release
film_age_ratings_five_levels.summary: Films and games are labelled "Freigegeben ohne Altersbeschränkung", "ab sechs Jahren", "ab zwölf Jahren", "ab sechzehn Jahren" or "Keine Jugendfreigabe".

goods_agreed_features_count_as_defect_st.title: Bought item must have the agreed features, suit the agreed use and come with the agreed accessories and manuals
goods_agreed_features_count_as_defect_st.summary: Under the subjective requirements, an item is free of defects if it has the agreed quality, suits the use assumed in the contract, and is delivered with the agreed accessories and instructions, including assembly and installation instructions. Quality covers type, quantity, functionality, compatibility and interoperability.
keywords: item does not match listing description

legal_defect_third_party_rights_on_item.title: Legal defect: you bought an item that a third party can claim rights to
legal_defect_third_party_rights_on_item.summary: An item is free of legal defects if third parties cannot assert any rights against the buyer, or only rights the buyer took over in the contract. A right wrongly entered in the land register counts as a legal defect too.
keywords: third party claims rights on purchased item

consumer_sale_includes_bundled_service.title: Consumer sale: buying goods from a trader still counts even if a service comes with it
consumer_sale_includes_bundled_service.summary: Consumer sales are contracts where a consumer buys goods from a trader. It is still a consumer sale if the contract also covers a service by the trader besides selling the goods.
keywords: goods plus installation service consumer sale

smart_goods_software_updates_owed.title: Smartphone or smart TV: the seller must make sure you get the updates needed to keep it working
smart_goods_software_updates_owed.summary: For goods with digital elements, the seller must ensure the buyer receives updates needed to keep the item in conformity, for the period the buyer can reasonably expect given the type and purpose of the goods and the circumstances.

seller_recourse_against_supplier_no_dead.title: Seller who had to take an item back can claim against the supplier without setting a new deadline
seller_recourse_against_supplier_no_dead.summary: A seller who sold a new item and had to take it back because of a defect, or who granted a price reduction, does not have to set the usually required deadline before using the buyer rights against the own supplier.

digital_product_must_match_agreed_featur.title: Paid app or streaming service: it must have the agreed features, work for the agreed use and come with agreed support
digital_product_must_match_agreed_featur.summary: A digital product meets the subjective requirements if it has the agreed quality, including quantity, functionality, compatibility and interoperability, suits the use assumed in the contract, and is provided with the agreed accessories, instructions and customer service.
keywords: paid app does not work as advertised

digital_product_defect_presumed_within_y.title: Paid digital product shows a fault within a year: it is presumed to have been faulty from the start
digital_product_defect_presumed_within_y.summary: If a digital product deviates from the requirements within one year of being provided, it is presumed to have been defective when provided.
keywords: digital product fault first year presumption
app defect burden of proof trader

digital_product_legal_defect_third_party.title: Digital product with a legal defect: you cannot use it without infringing someone else rights
digital_product_legal_defect_third_party.summary: A digital product is free of legal defects if the consumer can use it according to the subjective or objective requirements without infringing third-party rights.

digital_product_trader_proves_delivery.title: Dispute whether the paid digital product was ever delivered: the trader must prove it
digital_product_trader_proves_delivery.summary: Unlike the general rule, the trader carries the burden of proof that a digital product was provided as required.

bundle_contract_digital_part_rules.title: Package deal with physical goods and a digital service: the digital rules apply to the digital part
bundle_contract_digital_part_rules.summary: The digital product rules also apply to consumer contracts that, between the same parties, cover digital products together with other goods or services (package contract). They apply only to the parts of the contract concerning the digital products.

wage_garnishment_threshold_2026.title: Wage garnishment: from July 2026 net earnings up to 1,587.40 euro a month cannot be seized
wage_garnishment_threshold_2026.summary: From 1 July 2026 the unseizable amount under § 850c ZPO rises from 1,555.00 to 1,587.40 euro per month (365.33 per week, 73.06 per day).
keywords: how much wage protected from seizure

garnishment_above_threshold_three_tenths.title: Wage above the garnishment threshold: three tenths of the excess stays unseizable, more with dependants
garnishment_above_threshold_three_tenths.summary: If earnings exceed the basic threshold, three tenths of the excess is unseizable. For a debtor who provides maintenance, a further two tenths are unseizable for the first person and one more tenth for each of the second to fifth person.

car_driving_half_per_mille_offence.title: Driving a car with 0.5 per mille (0.25 mg/l breath) or more is an administrative offence even without any error
car_driving_half_per_mille_offence.summary: It is an offence to drive a motor vehicle on the road with 0.25 mg/l or more alcohol in the breath, 0.5 per mille or more in the blood, or an amount of alcohol in the body that leads to such a value. Both intentional and negligent driving count.
keywords: half per mille car driving limit

thc_blood_limit_3_5_ng.title: Driving with 3.5 ng/ml THC or more in the blood serum is an administrative offence
thc_blood_limit_3_5_ng.summary: It is an offence to drive a motor vehicle on the road with 3.5 ng/ml or more tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) in the blood serum.

driving_under_drug_effect_offence.title: Driving under the effect of an intoxicating substance listed in the annex is an offence
driving_under_drug_effect_offence.summary: It is an offence to drive a motor vehicle on the road under the effect of an intoxicating substance named in the annex of § 24a StVG. An effect exists when a listed substance is detected in the blood serum.

driving_ban_usually_for_24a_offence.title: Offences under § 24a StVG (alcohol or drugs while driving) usually come with a driving ban
driving_ban_usually_for_24a_offence.summary: For § 24a StVG offences the Bußgeldkatalog-Verordnung says a driving ban is usually imposed, with the duration set out in the catalogue entries.

warning_fee_5_to_55_euro.title: A traffic warning fee (Verwarnungsgeld) is a fixed amount between 5 and 55 euros
warning_fee_5_to_55_euro.summary: The Verwarnungsgeld is set at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50 or 55 euros. For trivial offences a warning without any fee is possible.

penalty_points_count_from_offence_date_o.title: Penalty points arise when you commit the offence, but only once the decision is legally final
penalty_points_count_from_offence_date_o.summary: Points in the Fahreignungs-Bewertungssystem arise with the commission of the criminal or administrative offence, provided it is penalised with legal effect.

fahreignungsseminar_point_deduction_once.title: A points seminar removes points only once within five years
fahreignungsseminar_point_deduction_once.summary: Attending a Fahreignungsseminar leads to a deduction of points only once within five years.

new_licence_wipes_earlier_points.title: When you are granted a new driving licence, points from earlier legally final decisions no longer count
new_licence_wipes_earlier_points.summary: If a driving licence is issued, points for decisions that became final before the issue are no longer considered and are deleted.

freedom_of_opinion_art_5.title: Everyone may express and spread their opinion freely, but general laws, youth protection and personal honour set limits
freedom_of_opinion_art_5.summary: Article 5 of the Basic Law protects expressing opinions in words, writing and images, and informing oneself from generally accessible sources. Press freedom is guaranteed and there is no censorship. These rights are limited by general laws, youth protection rules and the right of personal honour.
keywords: freedom of expression germany basic law

freedom_of_science_and_teaching_art_5_3.title: Art, science, research and teaching are free, but teaching does not release you from loyalty to the constitution
freedom_of_science_and_teaching_art_5_3.summary: The Basic Law declares art and science, research and teaching free. Freedom of teaching does not exempt from loyalty to the constitution.

secrecy_of_letters_and_telecoms_art_10.title: Letters, post and telecommunications are protected by the Basic Law and may be restricted only by a law
secrecy_of_letters_and_telecoms_art_10.summary: The privacy of correspondence, posts and telecommunications is inviolable. Restrictions may be ordered only on the basis of a law.

old_age_basic_security_who_qualifies.title: Grundsicherung im Alter: for people past the age limit or permanently fully disabled adults who cannot cover their living costs
old_age_basic_security_who_qualifies.summary: Grundsicherung im Alter und bei Erwerbsminderung goes to people who reached the age limit, or who are at least 18 and permanently fully unable to work, if they cannot cover their necessary living costs from their own income and assets. People born before 1 January 1947 reach the age limit at 65.

social_assistance_earnings_30_percent_de.title: In Sozialhilfe and Grundsicherung 30 percent of your work income is not counted
social_assistance_earnings_30_percent_de.summary: For Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt and Grundsicherung im Alter und bei Erwerbsminderung, 30 percent of income from employment or self-employment is deducted when income is counted.
keywords: how much of my work income

tax_assessment_four_year_limit.title: Finanzamt limitation: four years to set or change your tax; ten years for evasion, five for reckless understatement
tax_assessment_four_year_limit.summary: The limitation period for setting or changing a tax is four years for ordinary taxes (one year for excise taxes). It is ten years where tax was evaded and five years where it was recklessly understated.
keywords: how long can finanzamt go back

copyright_injunction_even_before_first_r.title: Copyright holders can demand removal and a cease-and-desist even if the infringement only threatens for the first time
copyright_injunction_even_before_first_r.summary: Anyone who unlawfully infringes copyright can be required to remove the impairment and, where repetition is a risk, to stop. The injunction claim also exists where a first-time infringement is merely threatening.
keywords: copyright cease and desist first offence

copyright_damages_licence_fee_basis.title: Copyright damages can be calculated as the licence fee you would have had to pay
copyright_damages_licence_fee_basis.summary: Someone who infringes intentionally or negligently owes damages. The claim can also be calculated from the fee the infringer would have had to pay if they had asked for permission to use the right.
keywords: how much damages photo use without permission

incidental_work_in_background_allowed.title: Protected works that only show up as incidental background in your photo or video may be used
incidental_work_in_background_allowed.summary: Reproducing, distributing and publicly showing works is permitted if they are incidental accessories next to the actual subject of the reproduction or presentation.

basic_supplier_must_supply_every_househo.title: The local default energy supplier must supply every household customer, on the same published terms and prices
basic_supplier_must_supply_every_househo.summary: In each network area the basic supplier (Grundversorger) must publish general terms and prices and supply every household customer on those terms. It may not distinguish by the time the basic supply contract was formed.
keywords: new customer same price as old customer basic supply

basic_supply_contract_two_weeks_notice.title: Electricity basic supply contract: you can cancel with two weeks notice
basic_supply_contract_two_weeks_notice.summary: The basic supply contract for electricity can be terminated with two weeks notice. The supplier can only cancel if it has no duty to supply you under the Energy Act.

energy_provider_switch_24_hours_2026.title: Switching energy supplier: since January 2026 the technical switch must happen within 24 hours on any working day
energy_provider_switch_24_hours_2026.summary: When switching supplier, the new supplier must promptly confirm in text form whether and when it can start supply. From January 2026 the technical switching process must be completed within 24 hours and be possible every working day. If the switch is late, the end customer can claim compensation from the party responsible.

energy_contract_text_form_and_confirmati.title: Energy supply contract outside basic supply: cancellation needs text form and the supplier must confirm within a week
energy_contract_text_form_and_confirmati.summary: Energy supply contracts with household customers outside the basic supply, and their cancellation by the supplier, need text form. The supplier must confirm the customer cancellation in text form within one week of receipt, stating the end of the contract.
keywords: energy contract cancellation confirmation one week

young_adult_youth_welfare_help_until_21.title: Youth welfare help for young adults normally runs until 21, longer in justified cases
young_adult_youth_welfare_help_until_21.summary: Help for young adults under the child and youth welfare law is generally granted only until age 21. In justified individual cases it should be continued beyond that for a limited period. The help is designed like help for young people, with the young adult taking the place of the parents or child.

youth_welfare_aftercare_after_help_ends.title: After youth welfare help ends, young adults still get counselling and support on becoming independent
youth_welfare_aftercare_after_help_ends.summary: Young adults are advised and supported within an appropriate period after the help ends, to the extent necessary and in an understandable form. The period and scope should be recorded in the help plan, and the youth welfare office should regularly make contact.
keywords: verselbständigung beratung nach ende der hilfe

mortgage_loan_withdrawal_expires_12_mont.title: Mortgage loan withdrawal right expires at the latest 12 months and 14 days after the contract
mortgage_loan_withdrawal_expires_12_mont.summary: The right to withdraw from a real-estate consumer loan contract expires at the latest twelve months and 14 days after the contract was concluded, or after the later date when the borrower received a copy of the application or contract.

foreigner_work_allowed_with_residence_ti.title: With a residence title you may work unless a law forbids it; a title must show whether work is allowed
foreigner_work_allowed_with_residence_ti.summary: Foreigners with a residence title may take up gainful activity unless a law prohibits it, and the activity may be limited by law. Every residence title must show whether gainful activity is allowed and whether restrictions apply. Restrictions from the Federal Employment Agency must be entered in the title.
keywords: may i work with my residence permit

employer_may_hire_foreigner_only_with_ti.title: Employers may hire a foreigner only if they hold a residence title with no ban or restriction on that work
employer_may_hire_foreigner_only_with_ti.summary: A foreigner may only be employed or commissioned for paid services if they have a residence title and no relevant ban or restriction applies. A foreigner without a residence title may only be employed under the conditions of paragraph 4.

police_questioning_right_to_remain_silen.title: Questioned as a suspect: you must be told the charge and that you may stay silent and talk to a lawyer first
police_questioning_right_to_remain_silen.summary: At the start of questioning the suspect must be told which act is alleged and which penal provisions may apply. They must be told they are free to comment on the accusation or not to say anything, and can consult a defence lawyer of their choice at any time, even before questioning. If they want a lawyer, they must be given information that makes contacting one easier, including lawyer emergency services.
keywords: right to remain silent police questioning

suspect_may_apply_for_court_appointed_la.title: A suspect can ask for evidence in their favour and, in serious cases, for a court-appointed defence lawyer
suspect_may_apply_for_court_appointed_la.summary: The suspect must also be told they may request individual pieces of evidence in their favour and, where the conditions of § 140 StPO are met, apply for a court-appointed defence lawyer (Pflichtverteidiger).

suspect_must_be_heard_before_investigati.title: Before the investigation ends the suspect must be heard; in simple cases a written statement is enough
suspect_must_be_heard_before_investigati.summary: The suspect has to be questioned before the investigation is concluded, unless the proceedings end in a discontinuation. In simple matters it is enough to give the suspect the chance to respond in writing.

statements_by_force_or_deception_unusabl.title: Statements obtained by forbidden interrogation methods can never be used, even if you agree
statements_by_force_or_deception_unusabl.summary: The ban on forbidden interrogation methods applies regardless of the suspect consent. Statements obtained in breach of it may not be used as evidence even if the suspect agrees to their use.

criminal_complaint_deadline_three_months.title: Offences prosecuted only on request, such as trespass: file the complaint within three months of learning of the act and offender
criminal_complaint_deadline_three_months.summary: An offence that is only prosecuted on request is not prosecuted if the entitled person does not file the request within three months. The period starts at the end of the day on which they learn of the act and the offender. If it ends on a weekend or holiday it runs to the next working day.

private_prosecution_for_insult_trespass_.title: For trespass, insult and property damage you can bring a private prosecution yourself
private_prosecution_for_insult_trespass_.summary: Trespass (§ 123 StGB), insult (§§ 185 to 189 StGB, unless aimed at certain political bodies) and damage to property (§ 303 StGB) are among the offences that can be pursued by private prosecution.

insult_penalty_up_to_one_year.title: Insulting someone can mean up to a year in prison or a fine; online or public insults can be punished more heavily
insult_penalty_up_to_one_year.summary: Insult is punished with imprisonment of up to one year or a fine. If it is committed publicly, in a meeting, by spreading content or by an assault, the penalty is higher.

minijob_short_term_three_months_or_70_da.title: Short-term employment: limited to three months or 70 working days a year, unless it is a main profession above the earnings limit
minijob_short_term_three_months_or_70_da.summary: A job counts as marginal if it is limited by nature or by prior contract to at most three months or 70 working days within a calendar year, unless it is done professionally and the earnings exceed the marginal limit.

marginal_earnings_limit_formula.title: The Minijob limit is the minimum wage times 130 divided by three, rounded up
marginal_earnings_limit_formula.summary: The marginal earnings limit is calculated by multiplying the minimum wage by 130, dividing by three and rounding up to full euros. The Federal Ministry of Labour announces it in the Federal Gazette.

minijob_pension_opt_out_application.title: Minijobbers can apply in writing to be released from pension insurance
minijob_pension_opt_out_application.summary: People in marginal employment are exempted from compulsory pension insurance on request. The exemption request is made to the employer in writing or electronically, and the employer reports it to the collection office.

heating_cost_split_50_to_70_percent_cons.title: Central heating: 50 to 70 percent of the costs must be split by your measured consumption
heating_cost_split_50_to_70_percent_cons.summary: Of the costs of operating the central heating system, at least 50 and at most 70 percent must be distributed according to the heat consumption recorded for each user. The same range applies to the central hot water system.

advance_utility_payments_only_reasonable.title: Advance payments for utility costs may only be agreed in a reasonable amount
advance_utility_payments_only_reasonable.summary: Parties can agree that utility costs are charged as a flat rate or as advance payments, but advance payments may only be agreed in an appropriate amount.

minimum_wage_due_last_banking_day_next_m.title: Minimum wage must be paid on the agreed date, at the latest the last bank working day of the following month
minimum_wage_due_last_banking_day_next_m.summary: The employer must pay the minimum wage at the agreed due date, and at the latest on the last bank working day (Frankfurt am Main) of the month following the month in which the work was done.
keywords: when must wages be paid latest

minimum_wage_2027_increase.title: The minimum wage rises to 14.60 euros gross per hour on 1 January 2027
minimum_wage_2027_increase.summary: The Fifth Minimum Wage Adjustment Ordinance sets the minimum wage at 13.90 euros gross per hour from 1 January 2026 and 14.60 euros from 1 January 2027.

labour_court_payment_order_one_week.title: Payment order (Mahnbescheid) from the labour court: the period to react is one week, not two
labour_court_payment_order_one_week.summary: In the labour court payment order procedure the period named in the Mahnbescheid is one week.
keywords: labour court payment order one week
wage claim payment order labour court

minor_age_seven_capacity.title: Contract capacity of children and teenagers
minor_age_seven_capacity.summary: A child who has not turned seven cannot make a valid contract at all. From seven until the 18th birthday a minor has only limited capacity to contract, so most deals depend on the parents.

declaration_void_unconscious_or_disturbe.title: Declarations made while unconscious are void
declaration_void_unconscious_or_disturbe.summary: A declaration of intent by a person incapable of contracting is void. The same applies to one made while unconscious or in a temporary disturbance of mental activity.

incapable_adult_everyday_transactions.title: Everyday purchases by an adult who cannot contract
incapable_adult_everyday_transactions.summary: If an adult incapable of contracting makes an everyday transaction with low-value means, the contract counts as effective once performance and consideration have been exchanged. This does not apply where there is considerable danger to the person or their assets.

relatives_in_direct_line_owe_support.title: Who owes maintenance
relatives_in_direct_line_owe_support.summary: Relatives in the direct line, such as parents and children, are obliged to support each other.

maintenance_only_if_unable_to_support_se.title: Only those who cannot support themselves get maintenance
maintenance_only_if_unable_to_support_se.summary: Only a person who is unable to support themselves is entitled to maintenance. A minor child with own assets can still demand support from the parents where income from assets and work do not suffice.

maintenance_includes_vocational_training.title: Maintenance covers training costs
maintenance_includes_vocational_training.summary: The amount of maintenance follows the living standard of the person in need. It covers the whole cost of living including the cost of appropriate education for a profession.

minimum_maintenance_age_brackets.title: Minimum maintenance for minor children
minimum_maintenance_age_brackets.summary: Minimum maintenance has three age brackets: 87 percent up to age six, 100 percent from seven to twelve, and 117 percent from 13, of the child's tax-free subsistence minimum. The first bracket is 486 euros a month from 1 January 2026.

welfare_office_claim_against_relatives_h.title: Welfare claims against relatives and hardship
welfare_office_claim_against_relatives_h.summary: When social assistance is paid, claims against relatives liable for maintenance can pass to the welfare office. They do not pass if the relative would be entitled to basic security benefits themselves or if the transfer would be an unreasonable hardship.

welfare_claim_transfer_by_written_notice.title: How the welfare office takes over a claim
welfare_claim_transfer_by_written_notice.summary: The social assistance office can have a claim against a third party pass to itself, up to its expenses, by written notice. It covers the period of uninterrupted payment, and a gap of more than two months counts as an interruption.

work_contract_basic_duties.title: Contract for work: what each side owes
work_contract_basic_duties.summary: Under a contract for work the contractor must produce the promised work and the customer must pay the agreed price.

work_acceptance_cannot_be_refused_minor_.title: Acceptance of finished work
work_acceptance_cannot_be_refused_minor_.summary: The customer must accept work made as agreed and cannot refuse acceptance over insignificant defects. Work also counts as accepted if the contractor sets a reasonable deadline and the customer does not refuse it naming at least one defect; a consumer must be warned of this first.

work_contract_customer_can_terminate.title: Ending a contract for work early
work_contract_customer_can_terminate.summary: The customer can terminate the contract at any time until the work is complete. Both sides can also terminate for good cause without notice if continuing until completion is unreasonable, and partial termination is possible for a separable part.

guarantee_needs_written_form.title: A guarantee must be in writing
guarantee_needs_written_form.summary: A guarantee (Bürgschaft) is only valid if the declaration is given in writing. Electronic form is excluded, but a missing form is cured once the guarantor pays the main debt.

guarantor_promises_to_answer_for_debt.title: What a guarantor promises
guarantor_promises_to_answer_for_debt.summary: By a guarantee contract the guarantor promises the creditor to answer for the third party's debt. A guarantee can also cover a future or conditional debt.

loan_borrower_exit_after_ten_years.title: Ending a loan after ten years
loan_borrower_exit_after_ten_years.summary: A borrower can terminate a loan in any case after ten years from full receipt with six months' notice. If the fixed interest rate ends early without a new agreement, one month's notice is possible for the end of that day.

loan_without_repayment_date_three_months.title: Loan with no repayment date
loan_without_repayment_date_three_months.summary: If no repayment time is set, the loan becomes due only when the lender or the borrower gives notice. The notice period is three months, and with an interest-free loan the borrower may repay without notice.

loan_borrower_pays_interest_and_repays.title: Basic duties under a loan contract
loan_borrower_pays_interest_and_repays.summary: The lender must make the agreed sum available and the borrower must pay any interest owed and repay the loan when due. Interest is due after each year, or on repayment if that comes sooner.

pension_regular_age_67.title: Regular old-age pension
pension_regular_age_67.summary: The regular old-age pension requires reaching the regular retirement age and meeting the general waiting period. The regular retirement age is reached at 67.

pension_partial_at_least_ten_percent.title: Taking a partial pension
pension_partial_at_least_ten_percent.summary: Insured people can claim an old-age pension in full or as a partial pension of at least 10 percent of the full pension.

disability_pension_three_hours_test.title: Pension for reduced earning capacity
disability_pension_three_hours_test.summary: Fully incapacitated for work are insured people who, because of illness or disability and for the foreseeable future, cannot work at least three hours a day under normal labour-market conditions. The general waiting period must be met before the reduction started.

severance_offer_half_month_per_year.title: Statutory severance for an operational dismissal
severance_offer_half_month_per_year.summary: If the employer dismisses for urgent operational reasons and notes in the notice that severance can be claimed, the employee gets it when no dismissal protection suit is filed in time. It is 0.5 monthly earnings per year of service, and more than six months rounds up to a full year.

severance_monthly_earnings_definition.title: What counts as monthly earnings
severance_monthly_earnings_definition.summary: Monthly earnings for severance mean what the employee is owed in cash and benefits in kind for the regular working time in the month the employment ends.

after_won_dismissal_suit_earnings_credit.title: Other earnings are credited after a won dismissal suit
after_won_dismissal_suit_earnings_credit.summary: If the employment continues after the court decision, the employee must have other earnings credited against the pay the employer owes for the time after dismissal.

new_job_refuse_return_within_one_week.title: Refusing to go back after winning a dismissal suit
new_job_refuse_return_within_one_week.summary: If the employment continues by court decision but the employee has meanwhile started a new job, they can refuse to continue with the old employer within one week after the judgment becomes final. The old employment ends when the declaration arrives.

pain_money_for_injury_to_body_or_health.title: Pain and suffering money after an injury
pain_money_for_injury_to_body_or_health.summary: If someone must pay damages for injury to body, health, freedom or sexual self-determination, a fair compensation in money can also be claimed for non-financial harm.

damaged_property_vat_only_if_paid.title: VAT on repair costs after property damage
damaged_property_vat_only_if_paid.summary: When property is damaged, the money claimed for repair includes VAT only if and to the extent it was actually incurred. With a fictitious repair bill, VAT is not paid out.

no_parking_five_metres_before_junction.title: Where parking is not allowed
no_parking_five_metres_before_junction.summary: Parking is not allowed within 5 m before and after junctions, measured from the points where the kerb lines meet, or 8 m where a bike path runs next to the road. It is also banned in front of driveways and where it blocks marked parking spaces.

stopping_banned_fire_service_access.title: Fire service access and no stopping zones
stopping_banned_fire_service_access.summary: Stopping is not allowed on narrow or blind stretches, in sharp bends, on railway crossings, or in front of and in official fire service access routes. Parking in a fire access costs 55 euros, and 100 euros if it holds up a rescue vehicle on call.

parking_means_leaving_car_or_over_three_.title: When stopping counts as parking
parking_means_leaving_car_or_over_three_.summary: Whoever leaves their vehicle or stops longer than three minutes is parking, not just stopping.

green_arrow_stop_first_then_turn_right.title: Green arrow sign at a red light
green_arrow_stop_first_then_turn_right.summary: Turning right on red is only allowed after stopping if a green-arrow sign sits to the right of the red light. A green arrow signal means traffic is released only in the arrow's direction.
keywords: green arrow turn right on red

red_light_over_one_second_fine_and_ban.title: Running a red light that was red for over a second
red_light_over_one_second_fine_and_ban.summary: Driving through a red phase that had already lasted longer than one second carries a regular fine of 200 euros and a one-month driving ban. A pedestrian ignoring a red signal pays 5 euros.
keywords: red light fine 200 euro driving ban

phone_at_the_wheel_only_hands_free.title: Phone use while driving
phone_at_the_wheel_only_hands_free.summary: A driver may use a phone or similar device only if it is not picked up or held and either voice control is used or a glance at it is brief and fits traffic conditions. Navigation devices, tablets and media players count as such devices too.

product_maker_liable_for_defect_injury.title: Producer liability for defective products
product_maker_liable_for_defect_injury.summary: If a product defect kills or injures someone or damages property, the producer must pay compensation. For property damage it applies only to another item normally meant for private use, and the injured person has to prove the defect, the damage and the link.

product_liability_property_damage_500_eu.title: Your own share for property damage under product liability
product_liability_property_damage_500_eu.summary: In the case of damage to property, the injured party bears the first 500 euros of the damage themselves.

product_liability_claim_negotiations_pau.title: Limitation in product liability claims
product_liability_claim_negotiations_pau.summary: While the parties negotiate about the damages, the limitation period is paused until one side refuses to continue. Otherwise the BGB limitation rules apply.

insurance_contract_basic_duties.title: What an insurance contract obliges each side to do
insurance_contract_basic_duties.summary: The insurer commits to cover a defined risk by paying a benefit when the agreed insured event happens. The policyholder must pay the agreed premium.

insurance_application_questions_must_be_.title: Truthful answers before taking out insurance
insurance_application_questions_must_be_.summary: Before making the contract declaration, the policyholder must disclose known risk circumstances the insurer asked about in text form. The insurer can only use remedies for a breach if it pointed out the consequences in a separate text-form notice, and not if it already knew the facts.

insurer_one_month_to_react_to_false_answ.title: Insurer must act within one month
insurer_one_month_to_react_to_false_answ.summary: The insurer has to assert its rights after a breach of the duty to disclose within one month in writing, counted from when it learned of the breach.
keywords: insurer one month rescind false information

beer_wine_not_to_under_16.title: Beer and wine and the age of 16
beer_wine_not_to_under_16.summary: In restaurants, shops or anywhere in public, beer, wine, sparkling wine and mixes of them with non-alcoholic drinks must not be given to children and teenagers under 16. This does not apply if a parent or guardian accompanies a teenager.

spirits_and_mixed_drinks_not_to_under_18.title: Spirits and strong drinks are for 18 and over
spirits_and_mixed_drinks_not_to_under_18.summary: Other alcoholic drinks, and foods containing more than a small amount of them, must not be given to minors under 18, and they must not be allowed to consume them.

alcohol_vending_machine_ban_public.title: No alcohol from public vending machines
alcohol_vending_machine_ban_public.summary: Alcoholic drinks must not be offered in vending machines in public places, unless a machine is in a place not open to minors or is set up so that children and teenagers cannot get at it.

public_dance_events_under_16_midnight_li.title: Public dance events for young people
public_dance_events_under_16_midnight_li.summary: Children and teenagers under 16 must not be allowed at public dance events without a parent or guardian. Teenagers from 16 may stay at most until midnight without such company.

eu_citizen_not_working_needs_health_cove.title: EU citizens who do not work
eu_citizen_not_working_needs_health_cove.summary: Non-working EU citizens, including students, have the right to enter and stay if they have adequate health insurance and adequate means of subsistence. Their accompanying family members have the same right.

eu_citizen_permanent_residence_after_fiv.title: Permanent residence for EU citizens
eu_citizen_permanent_residence_after_fiv.summary: EU citizens who have lived lawfully and continuously in Germany for five years get the right of permanent residence, whether or not the other residence conditions are still met.
keywords: EU citizen permanent residence five years

fake_invoice_fine_up_to_100000_euro.title: Fake invoices and receipts
fake_invoice_fine_up_to_100000_euro.summary: Issuing or circulating a receipt that falsely pretends work, services or a delivery took place, and so enables undeclared work or unlawful employment, is an administrative offence with a fine of up to 100,000 euros.

customs_can_check_id_for_undeclared_work.title: Customs checks for undeclared work
customs_can_check_id_for_undeclared_work.summary: Customs authorities checking for undeclared work may stop people, ask for their personal details and require the ID papers they carry to be handed over. They may check that the papers are genuine and establish the holder's identity.

coercion_attempt_punishable_severe_cases.title: Coercion
coercion_attempt_punishable_severe_cases.summary: An attempt at coercion (Nötigung) is also punishable. In especially serious cases, for example forcing a pregnant woman into an abortion or an official abusing his powers, the sentence is six months to five years in prison.
keywords: besonders schwerer Fall sechs Monate fünf Jahre

damages_after_termination_caused_by_othe.title: Damages when the other side forced you to quit
damages_after_termination_caused_by_othe.summary: If a termination was provoked by the other party's breach of contract, that party must pay the damage caused by the end of the relationship.
keywords: damages termination breach of contract other party

apprentice_important_reason_termination_.title: Two-week limit for terminating a training contract for cause
apprentice_important_reason_termination_.summary: A termination for important reason in training is invalid if the facts were known to the person entitled to terminate for longer than two weeks. If an out-of-court conciliation procedure has started, the period is paused until it ends.
keywords: apprentice termination for cause two weeks
Tatsachen bekannt länger als zwei Wochen

employment_contract_terms_freely_agreed_.title: Freedom of contract in employment
employment_contract_terms_freely_agreed_.summary: Employer and employee can freely agree on making, content and form of the employment contract, unless mandatory law, an applicable collective agreement or a works agreement stands in the way. Proof of essential terms follows the Nachweisgesetz.

elterngeld_67_percent_max_1800.title: Elterngeld: 67 percent of earlier income, capped at 1,800 euro
elterngeld_67_percent_max_1800.summary: Elterngeld is 67 percent of the income from work before the birth. It is paid up to a maximum of 1,800 euro a month for full months in which the person has no income from work. Above 1,200 euro of earlier income the percentage drops by 0.1 points per 2 euro, down to 65 percent.

elterngeld_basis_until_14th_month.title: Basiselterngeld can be taken until the 14th month of the child
elterngeld_basis_until_14th_month.summary: Elterngeld can be drawn from the day of birth. Basiselterngeld can be taken until the child has completed 14 months of life, while Elterngeld Plus can run longer.

elterngeld_300_euro_disregarded_other_be.title: Up to 300 euro of Elterngeld is not counted against other benefits
elterngeld_300_euro_disregarded_other_be.summary: For other means-tested benefits, Elterngeld is left out as income up to 300 euro a month, or up to the amount of the earlier work income taken into account under § 2.

alg_duration_depends_on_insurance_time_a.title: How long unemployment benefit lasts depends on insured time and age
alg_duration_depends_on_insurance_time_a.summary: The length of the claim to Arbeitslosengeld depends on how long you were in insured employment within the rahmenfrist extended by 30 months, and on your age when the claim arises. With the short qualifying period of 6 months you get 3 months, with 8 months 4 months and with 10 months 5 months, whatever your age.

alg_severance_can_pause_benefit.title: A severance payment can pause unemployment benefit
alg_severance_can_pause_benefit.summary: If the employment ended earlier than the employer notice period allowed and you got a severance payment, the Arbeitslosengeld is paused from the end of the job until the day the notice period would have ended. The pause lasts at most one year.

zpo_767_objection_to_enforcement.title: Vollstreckungsabwehrklage: sue if the debt itself no longer exists
zpo_767_objection_to_enforcement.summary: If you claim that the debt in a judgment has been paid or otherwise ended, you raise this by an action at the court of first instance. It only works for reasons that arose after the last oral hearing in which they could have been raised.

zpo_811a_exchange_seizure.title: Austauschpfändung: exempt items can be swapped for cheaper ones
zpo_811a_exchange_seizure.summary: A creditor can ask the court for an exchange seizure: an otherwise protected item is taken, and the debtor gets the money for a replacement from the proceeds. The court only allows it if it is reasonable, especially when the proceeds clearly exceed the value of the replacement.

zpo_811_unseizable_household_items.title: Items you need for a modest life cannot be seized
zpo_811_unseizable_household_items.summary: Things you or the people in your household need for a modest living and housekeeping are not subject to seizure, and neither are items needed for health reasons or private records whose use would intrude on personal rights.

mutterschutz_six_weeks_before_eight_afte.title: Maternity protection: six weeks before and eight weeks after birth
mutterschutz_six_weeks_before_eight_afte.summary: An employer may not employ a pregnant woman in the last six weeks before the birth unless she expressly agrees, and she can withdraw that at any time. After the birth she may not be employed for eight weeks. The date of birth given in the medical certificate decides the start.
